Chapter Notes

Hello! This fic is directly based on my comic about Mydei turning into a Chimera that I uploaded on Twitter , but it was getting too long and I lowkey don’t know how to draw so I decided to just write it instead. This allows me to expand on the story a lot more and add more depth to make it a full story instead.

Another thing to note is that I literally drew the original comic before the Awoo Firm event so for the sake of this fic to make sense nobody except Hyacine can speak Chimera and she’s far, far away on the Grove doing nerdy stuff with Anaxa and won’t make an appearance lmao.

(Also heads up English is not my native language so there might be a few mistakes)

This work has a Chinese translation ! Please feel free to read it if you can understand that one better!

Mydei has gone through a plethora of hardships throughout his whole life, by this point he was an expert at taking things up front and dealing with whatever life has decided to throw at him this time.

This specific hardship, however, takes the cake when it comes to the sheer absurdity of it all.

Today had started like any other day, by waking up on his bed.

When Mydei opened his eyes, his brain was still in between the realm of sleep and being awake. He, however, quickly noted that his bed seemed way huger than it should have and the night clothing he wore last night to sleep was sprawled on his bed as if he had taken it off, which he didn’t remember doing.

It was odd to say the least, he blamed it on the fact that he was still sleepy but quickly realized that something was genuinely wrong.

When he finally decided to get up, he noticed that he instinctively did so in all fours, (which was extremely weird as well), but his legs didn’t bend like they would normally do if a human were to try to walk in all fours.

No, they were definitely shorter, he was standing like an actual quadruped animal.

Mydei felt a sudden dread form in his chest, something like that couldn’t be happening.

Without wasting a second more Mydei looked down at his arms, but they weren’t his arms anymore, now he was looking at a pair of soft fluffy Chimera’s front legs.

The remaining sleepiness he once held dissipated at that moment. He couldn’t believe his eyes, was he seriously turned into a Chimera?

In his panic he forgot that his bed was huge, and he is now small and instead of getting out of bed he fell down face flat into the floor.

Ignoring the pain, Mydei approached the body size mirror he had in the corner of his bedroom, he needed to see it with his own eyes.

Upon looking at himself in the mirror, he quite literally couldn’t recognize himself.

He truly had turned into a Chimera overnight.

Somehow.

Mydei was now extremely small compared to when he was a human, his legs now shorter with small red claws that came out of his paws. His Chimera fur was a vibrant orange with a soft cream color that extended from half of his face to his underbelly and legs. He had a tail now, long and scaly, that faded from orange to a yellowish green at the end of it. His ears were small, his neck covered by soft dark red fur. The top of his head lacked any horns, and his back wasn’t adorned with wings unlike other Chimeras.

Yet his eyes were noteworthy, while he maintained the shape of a normal Chimera’s eyes, the color remained the exact same as his.

That was the only trace of his human self he had left.

In the end, he was a very plain-looking Chimera, but still a Chimera, nonetheless.

Now, what in the world Mydei did to be turned into such a weakened creature is beyond him, but as things stand, he needed help and quickly.

The more reasonable thing would be to ask Aglaea or Tribios for help. The two were demigods and have seen and have more experience than him, if there’s someone who could help him, it would be them.

Despite it still being the Entry Hour Mydei knew the two would often partake in a morning bath, so if he was quick enough, he could probably catch up to them both and ask for assistance.

After shamelessly having to get out of the house by the windows (the door was locked and he couldn’t reach the keyhole, let alone grab the keys) Mydei made his way to the baths with confidence, his attention directly ahead of him.

To the onlookers it seemed as if a Chimera had escaped the Garden of Life to parade across the Holy City, yet nobody dared to disturb him on his stroll.

When Mydei finally arrived at the baths he made his way directly to the Hero’s Bath, with the confidence of someone who belonged there (because he did) again not realizing the amount of odd looks he was receiving.

It wasn’t unheard of Chimeras being in the baths, it’s just that they were often in groups and usually came to relax after work and they were always supervised by a human.

So, finding a loner Chimera moving around the baths as if he owned the place was more than strange.

When Mydei reached the elevator, he realized a crucial fact.

He was too short and couldn’t press the button to call the elevator.

Just another challenge set to him by life, nothing he couldn’t handle.

Mydei figured he only needed to jump high enough to press it, so he prepared himself to jump by positioning himself directly in front of the switch, his legs bending preparing to get the momentum he needed for the jump.

The moment he finally leaped he felt as if he was flying, in fact he was floating? No, it was neither, someone had picked him up the moment he jumped, and that someone was-

“Hello little guy! I see that you want to enter here, but I’m sorry to inform you that you cannot pass into this area”

Phainon

This guy cannot possibly be doing this to him right now. Aglaea and Tribios are right up there, and this man is holding him like a lost Chimera that he technically is but shouldn’t be and doesn’t want to be.

He expected Phainon to put him down again, but he looked dead into his eyes instead analyzing him “Wow, looking at you more closely now, your eyes look exactly like Mydei’s…”

No shit, who do you think you are looking at.

Mydei just couldn’t deal with this right now “This is not funny deliverer unhand me this instant!” Or that’s what he meant to say but what came out of him was the pitiful sounds of a Chimera “Awoo, aww awoowo!”

Phainon stayed silent for a second, and for a moment Mydei thought that he had understood him, but he was sorely mistaken “So adorable! You’re exactly like him! I need you two to meet each other!”

What does that even mean!? He doesn’t need to meet himself, he’s right here!

“Deliverer, I’m right here there’s no need for anyone to meet anybody”

But Phainon didn’t understand. He had already made up his mind, he grabbed Mydei with one arm and started making his way out of the baths, and Mydei could do nothing more than to watch as how the Hero’s Bath grew smaller and smaller as he was carried away into the city.

Mydei didn’t like to admit it, but he was extremely weak right now. Phainon’s grip, while not constrictive or harsh, was just impossible to wiggle out off, he had given up trying after a few attempts at getting out.

Unable to do anything, Mydei decided to just let Phainon be Phainon and let him figure out that he was making a fool out of himself on his own.

They stroll around the Holy City all while Phainon shouted his name around places Mydei often visits, the training grounds, the fruit stall at the market, the restaurants, all (obviously) to no avail.

Then Phainon reached the roof of one of the houses in the Marmoreal Market that Mydei usually frequents, the one he goes to when he wanted time alone to look over Okhema and its citizens. In that place he could find some peace, mindlessly watching the rainbows and clouds at the far distance, hearing the idle chatting of people underneath while he basked in Kephale’s Dawn Device radiant sunshine.

But Phainon didn’t find Mydei enjoying his time alone but rather found an empty rooftop.

At that moment, Phainon came to a stop.

Mydei was truly nowhere to be seen, or at least he guessed that’s what Phainon thought.

Phainon then grabbed Mydei with both hands and moved him directly in front of him so he could see the Chimera more properly “Just where did he go? He’s nowhere to be seen and we’ve been all around the Holy City at this point”

Take a wild guess Mydei thought unsurprised, why is he even asking a Chimera about that anyway?

Then he saw a glimmer in Phainon’s eye, as if he had come up with a brilliant idea “Oh I know! Aglaea probably sent him on a new mission, let’s go ask her”

Wasting my time Mydei thought, he really moved him all around the city only to end up in the very same place he wanted to go in the first place but was denied access to, great.

Mydei sighed, at least they were going to talk to Aglaea, and he wouldn’t have to bother with the elevator…

Mydei feels like this was going to be a long day.

Upon reaching the Hero’s Bath Mydei noticed that unsurprisingly Tribios was already nowhere to be found and Aglaea remained alone. She was gazing at the endless gold pouring down, mixing itself with the water underneath, forming a perfect combination of blue and gold.

Phainon interrupted her quiet moment, but she already knew that he was coming “Aglaea!” He greeted her with one hand while holding Mydei’s now little body on the other.

This was Mydei’s chance, he needed Aglaea to see him, then he could explain exactly what was happening.

“Sorry for troubling you so early in the day Aglaea but have you perhaps sent Mydei on a mission recently?” Phainon asked.

“No, I haven’t. Although I’ve seen than you been looking for him all morning”

Unfortunately, Phainon was holding him in such a way that prevented Aglaea from being able to see him and no matter how much he wiggled he couldn’t break free from Phainon’s grasp.

Damn it Deliverer is this how you treat animals?

“Oh, it’s just that I’ve been looking for him to show him something”

The conversation kept going on, Phainon explaining the reason why he wanted to talk to Mydei, Aglaea saying something about her threads.

Mydei didn’t care, he needed to get out. But he couldn’t break free no matter how much he struggled, to the point that it was getting on his nerves.

When the conversation seemed to be ending and Phainon was ready to leave, Mydei deemed that his next action was a necessity.

He was not one to initiate violence without reason, but he thinks this time it was very much valid.

So, he bit Phainon with all the force that he had.

And by that he means he barely managed to make a tiny dent on his armor.

That at least got Phainon by surprise, catching Aglaea’s attention along the way “Oh dear” 

By that point Mydei was letting all his frustration onto Phainon’s arm whilst doing absolutely 0 damage “No, no, no little buddy we don’t bite people”

The Phainon grabbed him with both hands lifting him up in the air, Mydei spared no time in trying to scratch at his face

“Dammed Deliverer, put me back on the floor right this instant!” More awoos left his mouth, it was an order that won’t be understood.

“Such a fighting spirit! You really are like him” Phainon said in glee as he holds him in place, not caring about the sudden aggression the Chimera displayed.

Aglaea merely shook her head “Phainon, please refrain from bringing Chimeras into the Hero’s Bath without prior notice” 

“Haha, yes sorry. We’ll leave now, thank you for the information”

“No, no! Don’t leave-“

But it was too late, Phainon had turned his back and left, now Mydei wasn’t able to even see Aglaea.

And there goes his chance to talk to her, great.

Mydei felt himself deflate, he had never felt so useless in his life.

He had to admit that losing his temper because of Phainon was also to blame for this blunder.

Worst of all he felt tired. He had barely done something yet this new body of his was already drained of most of his energy, it was ridiculous. This new form could be nothing more distant from his human body and Mydei hated it.

After a few long strides and beats of silence Phainon spoke up again “Well, Aglaea didn’t know where Mydei was but maybe we can ask Tribbie. She’s usually near here in the Garden of Life” His ears perked up at the mention on Tribios, maybe he still had a chance after all.

“Also, there’s a lot of Chimeras for you to hang out with!”

That is also true, if there’s a place where Chimeras are more prominent, it is in the Garden of Life. That being said, he doubts very much they’ll be able to help him.

Then Phainon suddenly stopped “Wait a second, now that I think about it, you haven’t escaped from your work duties to relax at the baths, have you?”

What nonsense, Mydei would never abandon his duties in order to relax- wait he speaks as if he’s a Chimera. Of course he doesn’t do their work, he’s a human.

“For the last time Deliverer, I’m not a Chimera” He retorted only for cute sounds to come out of his mouth.

“Haha, don’t worry, I won’t tell anybody” 

This idiot

It was a short walk from the Hero’s Bath to the Garden of Life, upon reaching it Tribbie was near her usual spot, looking at the Chimeras playing around during their free time. “Hello Tribbie”

Upon hearing Phainon’s voice Tribbie turned around and greeted him with a big smile “Snowy!”

Then Tribbie realized that Phainon wasn’t alone “Oh, hi! is this a new friend of yours?” She pointed at Chimera-Mydei with excitement.

“You could say so. I found him sneaking around near the Hero’s Baths today and you know what? After I picked him up, I realized he looked just like Mydei!”

“Wait really? Can we see?” Wait this could be his chance, surely someone as wise and long- lived as Tribios would be able to see exactly who he is just by looking.

“Of course!”

Ok, this is it.

Phainon grabbed him with both hands now, lowering him down so he could be in front of Tribbie so she may take a better look.

Please Lady Tribios, look into my eyes and realize who I truly am, Mydei though.

Her face was unreadable, she looked at him up and down as if she was examining a millennia old artifact that needed to be appraised.

The silence was getting to him, could she really tell or not?

After what it seemed like an eternity Tribios spoke up again “Wow, you are right Snowy! He looks exactly like De! He’s got the eyes and everything”

It’s over

If Lady Tribios can’t even recognize me, I don’t know what I have left.

If there’s was someone who could tell who he was It would be Tribios, but that doesn't seem to be the case.

He has heard that Hyacine has a blessing from Cerces that would make anyone be able to understand the Chimeras. However, she left for the Grove just a few days ago and she wasn’t sure if she would take weeks or even months to come back.

As the way things are right now, as people say nowadays, he is cooked.

Mydei felt defeated for the first time in ages, he stopped struggling in Phainon’s hold, just letting him grab him and do whatever he pleased.

He didn’t have the energy to do anything right now, he wanted to rest and come up with other ways to break free from the curse later.

“Um, we see that he’s a little bit under the weather though”

Phainon widened his eyes, realizing that maybe he wasn’t treating the Chimera gently this whole time “Oh, you are probably right. I’ve been holding him for a while now. I should put him back on the ground”

On cue, Phainon gently placed him on the grass underneath. His paws felt the gentle caress on the grass as he was placed down, he instinctively dug his claws on the ground feeling the cold earth underneath it.

It felt nice, for a second, before he was surrounded by Chimeras all striking different horns, tails and wings with various matching colors.

“A new coworker?”  Spoke a Chimera with long curving horns with soft brown colors and a sharp tail.

Another Chimera, completely dark violet with a single dark red horn answered “Awoo, look at him I’ve seen a few that look just like him, are we sure we are not confusing him with someone we know” it argues.

“I’m sure I would remember” Said a pink one with no horns but with white wings.

Mydei now tired and annoyed that he got his singular moment of peace stripped away from him answered them with a harsh tone “I’m not a Chimera, I’m a human”

All the Chimeras went silent, their big eyes all on him.

Various comments came one after the other.

“Don’t be silly, it is obvious that you are a Chimera”

“Well tell me human, when can we have a vacation?”

“Are you pretending to be a human so you can slack of during work? Tell me if it works so I can do the same…”

“Wohoo, a Human-Chimera! does that mean more work balance for us?”

Gods all these Chimeras are overworked

“That’s not-“ Before he could answer a red Chimera with two horns, one bigger than the other, interrupted him, “Are you all forgetting is our free time right now? Let’s go play!”  

“Yes, free time!”  They all said in unison as they drag him to play catch with everyone.

This day is getting way too long…

“Well, no. We haven’t seen De in all day” Tribbie said as she tried to recall the last time, he saw Mydei, Phainon had already filled her in about what happened “We are sorry, but we think last time we saw him was when he left with you and Cas after the bath yesterday”

Phainon let out a tired sigh “Yeah, we didn’t do much after that, just some idle chat before heading to our houses”

Phainon looked at the Chimeras, now seeing his new friend run around as he was getting chased down by the others in a game of tag “I spent the whole day today looking for him, but it is as if he just disappeared, not even Aglaea knows where he has gone to”

Where could Mydei have run off to? How did he escape Aglaea’s threads? How does nobody have seen him?  It’s not like Mydei is that hard to find with that ridiculous body of his.

“Well maybe an emergency popped up?” she tried to reason “Have you tried asking the Kremnoans?“

“No, I haven’t” Phainon didn’t really want to go ask them just now just in case Mydei really has gone missing, if they knew their Prince potentially got kidnapped who knows what they’ll try to do.

Ugh, what is he even thinking, how could Mydei even get kidnapped? He’s a grown 6’2 (190cm) feet tall grown man.

Even so he can’t seem to shake off his unease, Mydei would never abandon them, and if he indeed needed to go for whatever reason he would’ve said something.

But it’s just been less of a day, he didn’t need to panic just yet.

Mydei surely will show up sooner rather than later.

“If not even Agy can tell where he has gone to…” She dropped her arms, defeated “Sorry Snowy, we wish we could do something more to help”

 “No, no, its not a problem Tribbie. You telling me you haven’t seen him is good information as well” He tried to reassure Tribbie, Phainon knew she’s worried as well.

“Still, we wished we could do something more. We are also worried about De, he’s not the kind of guy to just go poof!”

Phainon couldn’t help but feel a knot forming on his neck, he really wasn’t that kind of person at all “I know…” it all he managed to say.

It’s still too early to tell, he told himself, trying to convince himself that he was exaggerating.

Tribbie managed to bring him back from his miserable thoughts “Don’t worry Snowy, we will be on the lookout! So, no more sad faces, okay?”

Was he really that terrible at controlling his facial expressions?

“Thank you, Tribbie I really mean it”

He was about to leave when Tribbie stopped him “Wait, we just realize something. You didn’t say you went to De’s house, right? You know Aglaea’s threads don’t reach our houses out of privacy, so, maybe De never left home today?”

Phainon blinked a few times, feeling like a buffoon. How come he didn’t think of checking in the most obvious place?

“I…didn’t. This is why you are our senior Tribbie, thank you very much for the insight”

She merely smiled at him “Its nothing Snowy. If you are going to his house, please text us if he’s there, we also want to know what happened to De”

“For sure, I’ll message you right away”

He waved goodbye to Tribbie, and now that she talks about texting, he realizes he could send Mydei some messages as well.

It seemed like Mydei was still in Okhema, given that the messages were being delivered, or at the very least his teleslate was.

Phainon didn’t wait for an answer and put back his teleslate in his pocket then headed out of the Garden of Life to go to Mydei’s house, when he suddenly felt his clothes getting pulled.

When he looked down to see the perpetrator that dared to tug Aglaea’s fine garments, he saw the little orange Chimera he had been dragging all day to show to Mydei.

He was biting down at his cape, trying to make Phainon not go away.

In all honestly, his initial plan had completely disappeared from his mind. What once was a funny coincidence he wished to share with his friend, now turned into a much more serious case of a missing person.

His now priority was finding Mydei, showing him the little Chimera could wait.

It was silly to think that the Chimera looked like Mydei, besides the eyes and his character he looked nothing like the man (for obvious reason).

He, however, looked exactly like the Chimera Mydei used to represent himself in those goofy videos he loved to animate, so it was easy for Phainon to link them both together.

“Hey buddy, it’s okay, you can stay here in the garden, I won’t bother you anymore”

He quickly crouched and petted the Chimera on the head, then got up and continued walking but the tugging at his cape continued.

The Chimera was still persistent in getting his attention. Phainon knew Chimeras could understand humans at least to a certain extent, so the Chimera was most likely ignoring him.

“What is it? You don’t want to stay here? You really are skipping work then”

The Chimeras eyes widen for a second only to drop down onto an unimpressed look.

Dear Kephale, it really looks just like Mydei when Phainon says something he would consider stupid.

“That’s not it? Don’t tell me you have grown attached to me and want to be in my company?” 

The Chimera froze for a second before answering with a bunch of noises that were too cute to describe “Awoo, wooo woawoo”

Phainon couldn’t understand a thing, he hasn’t bothered to get that particular blessing from Cerces despite studying in the Grove for so long, he never really thought it could be useful but now he wishes he did just to understand what the little guy was saying.

Well, if the Chimera want to go with him, he doesn’t mind the company “It’s okay, you can come with me if you’d like, but don’t expect me to carry you all around”

Phainon continued walking, at first, he thought the Chimera had left but he eventually saw him walking next to him.

Thank the gods they found a common ground, a moment more of his clothes getting munched and he’d have to go back to Aglaea for a quick fix and he didn’t want to bother her more than he already has.

Now every time Phainon started walking, the Chimera followed.

He “played” with the Chimeras, or more like they ran after him trying to catch him in their game of tag while Mydei was actually trying to get away from them.

With all the commotion, he could barely hear what Phainon was saying to Tribios, but no doubt they were talking about him.

When he finally managed to brush the other Chimeras off, Phainon was already by the door leading outside the Garden of Life.

Mydei quickly ran towards him to stop Phainon from getting away when Mydei realized, why was he stopping Phainon? It’s not like he needed him, or does he?

Before he could think about it further Phainon started talking  “Hey buddy it’s okay, you can stay here in the Garden I won’t bother you anymore”

Phainon crouched and petted him on the head, which stunned Mydei for a second before he noticed how Phainon continued to walk. Mydei could’ve just let Phainon go, he could solve this problem on his own then he wouldn’t have to burden his friend with his problems.

But something told him he should stay with Phainon, so he tugged at his clothes again, maybe a little harsher than before.

“What is it? You don’t want to stay here? So, you really are skipping work”

He’s caught by surprise by such comment, he’s not skipping work, he has no work to speak of! Even so he couldn’t help but feel offended at the comment.

“That’s not it? Don’t tell me you have grown attached to me and want to be in my company?” 

Mydei understands that this comment wasn’t actually directed at him, Mydei, yet he still couldn’t help but feel his face heat up (Chimeras had a natural constant blush so he hopes it wasn’t noticeable).

He can’t deny his ever-growing feelings for the man in front of him that have slowly but gradually increased over the years they spent together.

And every time Mydei thinks about his feelings he can’t help but ask himself the same question every single time.

How did he fell for this idiot?

“So, what if I had? What if I wanted to spend my waking moments alongside you? Would you still walk alongside me after you knew this Deliverer?” Mydei answered heartfeltly, forgetting for a moment that Phainon couldn’t actually understand him.

Phainon merely smiled while looking down at him completely unaware of Mydei’s confession “It’s okay, you can come with me if you’d like, but don’t expect me to carry you all around” 

Then Phainon continued walking, and just like that Mydei came back to reality.

He wasn’t Mydeimos the Undying, he wasn’t the crown Prince of Kremnos, he wasn’t a Chrysos Heir.

He was just a simple Chimera.

When they arrived at Mydei’s house his messages were still unanswered by Mydei, in fact he hadn’t even read them.

That simply wasn’t good, if Mydei was in Okhema he didn’t take this long to answer his messages.

He approached the door, ignoring the dread forming on his chest. He first tried knocking on the door, when he didn’t get an answer, he tried talking “Mydei, it’s me Phainon, could you open the door?”

When Mydei didn’t answer Phainon tried opening the door, only to find it locked.

Thankfully he had a spare key to the home since both of them had exchanged dupes of each other’s houses keys in case something happened.

Phainon didn’t like where this was going “I’m going to use the key you gave me okay?” he said out loud.

Again, no answer, Phainon opened the door.

He didn’t know what to expect, a mess? A sign of battle? But he found neither, Mydei’s house was as impeccable as ever.

Phainon made his way in, looking at every room, every corner, nothing was out of the ordinary.

Then he got to his bedroom, his bed was undone with sleeping clothes sprawled over them, it was the only sign that Mydei had been here last night.

Phainon sat down on the bed, he could see Mydei’s teleslate on his nightstand, mocking him.

Mydei was really truly gone.

He remembered he promised that he would text Tribbie, so he took his teleslate out of his pocket and texted her.

He left Tribbie on read, how could he not worry about it?

Mydei had left him, he left Phainon behind, he was not coming back he-

Phainon suddenly felt a warmth against his right side that pulled him back from his dreadful thoughts. The Chimera had jumped into the bed and was now trying to cuddle him, probably trying to comfort him.

Phainon breathed in and out, trying to calm himself, then grabbed the Chimera, put him on his lap and started to slowly caress his fur.

Now with a more clear mind he reasons that Mydei had no reason to leave, so something else must have been at play.

He couldn’t help but chuckle when the Chimera seemed annoyed when he tried to tug at his ear slightly.

Phainon felt immense joy, just having this little creature around was enough to put him in a good mood “Whatever would I do without you?” he said lovingly as he gave the animal a few more pets.

Phainon had dragged him all across the Holy City today, so much so that it was already the Parting Hour, but instead of heading back home Phainon was going back into the Marmoreal Market.

For what for Mydei had no idea, but if it was to go to a shop he had to do so as soon as possible, it was closing time after all.

When they reached the smithy, Mydei realized that he was quite exhausted, his body no longer holds the energy of a young adult but one of a small creature.

The whole day was a mess of going from place to place without much rest, and just now he had to keep up with Phainon’s unreasonable long legs as they strode across Okhema.

So, when he was left near the dying stove that still emitted some heat, it was understandable that he closed his eyes and got comfortable; whatever Phainon needed to do he didn’t need him, surely.  

“Chartonus! I’m sorry I’m bothering you at such an hour”

“Bothering me you are not, about ring you wonder?”

All and every ounce of sleep he had disappeared in a single second.

A ring? What kind of ring?

He opened his eyes looking at Phainon, he couldn’t possibly be serious, Chartonus had to have mixed something up.

Phainon of all people ordering Chartonus a ring? What for? Don’t tell Mydei Phainon is already-

“Oh, no don’t worry about it, is a careful and intricate work, right? Just take your time with it”

Mydei can’t believe his ears right now, Phainon ordering a detailed ring? What for? Phainon doesn’t use rings, in fact he had already mentioned his displeasure towards them so it couldn’t be for himself, which meant that it was for someone else-

Who in the world is Phainon going to give a ring to.

“Understand I do. New forging you want?”

“No not at all, is nothing related to forging” Phainon waved his hand side to side to dismiss the idea “I was just wondering if you know where Mydei has gone to. I’ve been looking for him all day, but he doesn’t seem to be in Okhema anymore”

The damn change in topic, what is going to happen to the ring?!

“Crown Prince I have not seen. Ask the Kremnoans you should” Chartonus wisely said, but Phainon didn’t seem that keen to the idea.

“I had that in mind already, I will do so in the right time, it has become rather late today”

“Late it is. Closing shop, I will” Chartonus said as he finished storing his tools in the right place.

 “Ring should be done soon. Come for it past tomorrow you should”

“That I will Chartonus, thank you for answering my question, have a good rest”

And just like that Phainon parted ways with Chartonus leaving Mydei with plethora of questions, he wishes he could speak right now and ask Phainon just what the hell is he thinking of doing with a ring off all things.

But Mydei knows, Mydei knows exactly what Phainon could be doing with a ring, but the tiny selfish part of him that refused to accept it was dominating him.

He just doesn’t understand who or how, when something might have happened, how does Mydei not know anything about it? It doesn’t make any sense-

Before he could continue his spiral of dread Phainon started talking “You seem tired, do you want me to pick you up?”

Mydei was so caught up on his thoughts, that he failed to realize that Phainon was walking like a snail to match his speed.

He looked up to see Phainon insufferable grin, Mydei wished he could kiss him, to make him his own, to make him forget.

But that was all that it was, wishful thinking, when had Mydei ever gotten anything he wanted in his life? This was no exception.

He hadn’t said anything when Phainon eventually picked him up, this time holding him as if he were holding a baby.

If Mydei wasn’t completely deadly tired he would’ve complained, but at the moment he was exhausted, and Phainon was warm and soft.

He felt his eyes closing more and more, the walking motion lulling him to sleep until eventually Mydei fell asleep in Phainon’s gentle embrace.

Chapter End Notes

Usually is Phainon taking the hits but I’m willing to bully Mydei because I believe in equality.
