Chapter Notes

I meant to upload this chapter sooner but a lot happened, and my free time went to other personal projects lol but I did say to myself I would get it out before 3.3 dropped and here I am updating it one day before it drops, go me.

Please enjoy more Mydei torture.

Mydei slowly woke up, his mind still turning on after his…nap? He opened his eyes and quickly realized he wasn’t at his house, and he was on the floor?

Oh yes, he forgot he was turned into a Chimera for no particular reason and now he has to deal with it.

He was clearly in Phainon’s house, it seems like he brought Mydei with him after he fell asleep on his arms yesterday.

Mydei is not going to dwell deeper on that fact.

He recognized his friend’s room, even if he hasn’t come around here as much as he would like and despite the fact that curtains were still down and the room light was quite dim, he could easily recognize the little things that made his room so…Phainon.

The concerning number of fake relics he had amassed in his pursuit to learn to appraise, his very well taken care of set of weapons, his wardrobe open and full of…questionable colored clothes. 

Phainon had apparently made a tiny makeshift bed on the floor out of blankets for him to sleep on, and despite being rather comfortable Mydei would rather not sleep on it. He was a human not an animal, much less a pet.

Mydei lifted his head to complain about it to the person responsible, since his bed was right beside him, but instead of complaining like he intended he gawked at the man before him.

Phainon was…about to fall off the bed, but that wasn’t what had Mydei’s whole attention.

The man was sleeping peacefully on his side, he could see his even breaths, his lips slightly parted, his face completely calm, lost in the realm of sleep.

Mydei’s eyes trailed lower, Phainon was sleeping with his bare chest, he could clearly see now the thin golden line tattoo he could only see when they shared a bath together.

From his downwards position, Mydei could barely catch a glimpse of his sun tattoo that lay on his neck, and to his surprise, his neck was completely bare, no chocker to be seen.

It felt wrong, Phainon usually wears that even to the baths, so to see his exposed neck  like this was just wrong.

Scratch that, seeing Phainon half-naked in his own home is wrong as it is, a breach of privacy Mydei would indulge no longer.

So, he adverted his sight. It was improper to gaze at his friend like that, much more if Phainon was indeed…thinking of marrying someone.

The sore thought made Mydei feel dejected, the reality of it still not sticking completely with him. 

Kremnoans would not partake much in the practices of Mnestia, giving rings to commemorate matrimony was not a thing most Kremnoans would indulge in.

His own mother would wear a signet ring, but it was mostly to commemorate Kingship rather than undying love.

That signet ring was now in the depths of the sea of souls, never to be seen again.

But Mydei knew what rings represented for most of Amphoreus, happiness, eternal union, love…

Mydei couldn’t help but look back at Phainon’s sleeping form.

Just who is the one that holds your affection?

Just as Mydei was pondering that, Phainon started to stir awake. He was as the man in front of him sat upright and yawned as he stretched his arms.

The yawn was quite contagious since Mydei himself wasn’t spared from it, letting out a weird-cute sounding yawn as he did so that surprised even himself.

He is very aware that Chimeras make the adorable sounds but hearing coming out of himself was still nothing he was getting used to, probably he will never get used to it if he’s honest.

Upon hearing the sound, Phainon turned and looked at him, a warm smile already plastered on his face this early in the day “Good morning! I see you are already awake”

Mydei barely let out a low awoo sound, not in the mood for Phainon’s overwhelming sunshine attitude.

“Not an early bird, are you? You seem rather down…”  Phainon tried to figure out what ailed Mydei tilting his head to the side, thinking until his eyes sparkled.

“Oh! I know. You went to sleep without eating dinner yesterday,  you are probably starving. Let’s have breakfast” Then Phainon promptly got up, quickly put on the ugliest green shirt Mydei had the displeasure of seeing, got the blackout curtains to the side and went to the kitchen.

Mydei guessed Phainon was right, he was indeed quite hungry, skipping meals wasn’t something he did, it wasn’t something anyone should do in fact.

Mydei finally got up from his makeshift bed and realized how stiff he was from sleeping so he started stretching his limbs out of instinct, exactly like a Chimera would do.

He stretched both of his front legs in front of him, while raising his butt into the air trying to find relief from his dormant muscles.

Mydei stopped as soon as he realized what he was doing.

Mydei couldn’t help but feel ashamed of his behavior. He did so out of instinct, as if such action was engraved in his mind.

It was normal, Chimeras stretch like that.

But Mydei wasn’t a Chimera.

Thanks all Titans dead or mad nobody is watching.

Opting to ignore the mortifying act he just committed, he searched for Phainon in the kitchen.

Now with proper lighting he was able to see his clothes more properly, he wears the ugly green shirt from before that now, in the light of Kephale’s Divine Dawn, Mydei could discern that it was worse than Mydei though.

It had a drawing of an amphora and a text that said “Holy City Appraisals” in the worst font Mydei had seen ever.

Where in the world did Phainon get this shirt from, it had to be a crime against humanity to create such a terrible set of clothes.

Mydei then made the mistake of seeing Phainon’s pants. He hadn’t noticed before, but he was wearing some purple baggy pants that had no business having that many pockets, Mydei could swear there were more pockets than pants at his point.

Mydei decided to just stop looking for his own sake.

It seemed like Phainon could only wear these types of clothing in the safety of his own home, if Aglaea were to catch wind of this Mydei’s sure Phainon wardrobe would be no more.

Castorice had shared with him that their professor had once joked how Phainon had been cursed by Mnestia themselves and Mydei for once would believe it.

Mydei decided the better course of action would be to jump to the chair next to Phainon and try to see what he was eating.

He did so and found that Phainon was eating  food that he (Mydeimos) has cooked for him and storge in his fridge because Phainon is a mess.

It is not like he isn’t capable of cooking, more so he isn’t exactly good at it, and would rather have Mydei’s brilliant cooking instead, or so he had claimed.

He would even eat the terrible food Mydei made for him in those occasions where Phainon managed to piss him off, saying that it was better than his own normal cooking which speaks volumes about his cooking abilities.

So Mydei might had cooked a bunch of food that could be refrigerated for breakfast lunch and dinner just for Phainon…

Listen- is paying off for him right now, because Mydei’s stomach is growling so much and good nutritious food is right there thanks to him.

Now that he thinks about it, he hasn’t eaten anything since he woke up yesterday as a Chimera, all the stress and panic adding up as the more the day went by…it wasn’t good.

He waited for Phainon to notice him, only to get annoyed when Phainon was too busy texting and mindlessly eating cold honeycackes to acknowledge the very angry hungry Mydei Chimera that was staring holes at him.

Who was he even texting? It wouldn’t be…

Mydei wasn’t a nosy person, not at all. But the thought of finding out the possible person that holds Phainon’s affection was too tempting to pass on, so he got into the table and took a peek at Phainon’s teleslate.

Mydei let a sigh of relief after he saw Aglaea’s contact on the screen only to feel his heart sunk after he read the conversation Phainon was having with her.

Phainon was in the middle of writing his next message when he noticed Mydei was snitching on his teleslate “Oh, soffy, yu af pfofafly feafly fanfy” …can’t this man finish eating before he speaks?

Mydei let out a humph or whatever a humph might sound like a chimera and jumped back into one of the chairs.

“You must really be starving. You didn’t move an inch yesterday when I tried to wake you up for dinner”

He…doesn’t even remotely recall Phainon trying to wake him, he must’ve been deadly tired…of being carried around and walking…gods what did he do to deserve this.

Mydei took the time to ponder about it, what exactly happened? He rewinds back in his memories, the day before he woke up changed.

That day he trained with Phainon like usual, he went to buy groceries, then he helped a group of Kremnoans with a dispute they were having…with a follower of Zagreus…

…

Gods.

Damn it.

It’s always then and their damned tricks, they hold no honor whatsoever, they rejoice in our suffering.

Mydei doesn’t even know how it’s possible but he’s quite sure that follower of Zagreus from the other day had at least something to do with his current situation.

“Wait what do Chimeras eat exactly?”

Ah yes Phainon is still here.

Mydei, despite really liking Chimeras, doesn’t really know the answer but if Phainon dares to give him anything raw like an actual animal he might do something  unpleasant.

“Well, we can share this honeycakes Mydei made for me recently, don’t worry I stored them very well, so they won’t go bad”

Phainon stood up and grabbed another plate from the shelf then placed a few honeycakes on it and started to cut them into tiny pieces.

“Here have at it. Tell me your thoughts later so I can tell them to the chef later” Phainon winked at him not knowing the chef himself was in front of him, about to eat his own food.

 He can, however, rate if Phainon did a good job at storing them as he claims.

Mydei ended up climbing the table since he couldn’t really eat properly on the chair. He took one bite, another, and another one until he had eaten half of his plate already, Phainon did a good job storing them. They will never taste like actual just made honeycakes but it’s the second-best thing.

Whilst Mydei was lost into the sweet flavor Phainon was staring at him, thinking “You know, I’ve been thinking. You don’t really have a name, do you?” Mydei freezes. He doesn’t like where this is going “How about I give you a nickname of sorts, just to not be going around calling you just Chimera” Oh no, no, no, de doesn’t trust Phainon naming things at all, much less naming Mydei.

“Since you look like my very best friend Mydeimos” Oh no “And you are very tiny and cute” No, no, no “I was thinking…” Please don’t

“Meowdeimos! Meowdei for short, isn’t that a cute name? I think it fits you” Phainon said looking like a big ball of sunshine. It thankfully wasn’t as bad as he thought it would be, it kind of sounds like his actual name…

Sure…he can live being called Meowdei…begrudgingly.

He did his best to sound convinced about the name, he was sure if he rejected it Phainon would come up with a much worse, much mortifying name for him.

“So, you do like it! I’m glad” Like it would be an understatement, tolerating would be more accurate.

Phainon had already finished his honeycakes long ago and was now washing the dishes. After Mydei had his fill, he also took his and cleaned it as well, Mydei was left wondering what he could do to get back to normal.

If it was an actual trick, it would probably go away on its own, the question would be more akin to when. It could take hours, days, maybe weeks.

He knows of a man that was plagued by a curse for two whole years only two disappear one morning as if nothing happened, turned out a follower of Zagreus had cursed him, and the spell simply had that long duration.

By Nikador please don’t make him a Chimera for two years he would not be able to take it.

He is troubling Aglaea and Tribios already, and Phainon is...

Honestly Mydei had never seen Phainon so heartbroken. Yesterday when they went to his house, Mydei thought of a line similar to “See Deliverer? Nobody is here, maybe start suspecting the Chimera that reminds you of your friend that conveniently appeared after your friend disappeared?”

But instead Phainon just, sit on the edge of the bed texted someone and dropped his teleslate.

Then he looked at the nightstand, gaze fixating on Mydei’s teleslate, eye void of emotion.

Mydei felt a chill, he had never seen Phainon like this.

It was wrong, so, so wrong to see Phainon like that.

He climbed the bed and out of instinct he simply cuddle next to Phainon trying to comfort him.

It should’ve been a mortifying endeavor but at the time it felt right, just what Phainon needed.

Mydei was really troubling his friends right now, the moment he gets his hands on that follower of Zagreus-

“Today I’ll keep looking for my friend” Phainon said, pulling Mydei out of his thoughts. Phainon sounded way more serious than a minute ago “If you wish to come you are welcomed to”

Is he really not going to give up until he finds Mydei? Aglaea already wants Phainon to stay put, yet he wants to keep looking, it isn’t like him to disregard her…

But if Phainon is to be on the lookout, Mydei could actually do something for the both of them and try to find that follower of Zagreus.

So Mydei agrees, and let’s out awoo to notify Phainon that he will indeed go out to him to look for well, himself “That sounds like a yes to me! Let’s go then!”

Phainon confidently ran to the door, put his hand on the handle only to turn around before he could open it.

“I can’t go out like this Aglaea would cut my head off” he murmured, if Mydei had hands he would’ve done a facepalm.

He was very much right though.  

After a change of clothes and Mydei did not peek because he is a gentleman and while they have seen each other naked multiple times in the baths being in a private home is completely different from being in the baths.   

They set foot outside and, well, Mydei didn’t have any idea where they were going, Phainon hadn’t specified exactly what they were going to do or how exactly he would look out for Mydei.

Still Mydei would be on the lookout not for himself but for that dammed hyena who did this to him.

They both walked around the Holy City, but he couldn’t see the specific man he was looking for. He recalls him having slightly long brown hair, green eyes and he was wearing a blue and white chiton when Mydei last saw him.

It was to no avail however, the man was nowhere to be seen, or at least Mydei couldn’t recognize him since his vision of the world right now wasn’t the best to speak of.

 With all his concentration going onto looking out for the wanted man and trying to not stray too far away from Phainon he failed to see where his friend was taking him.

They reached the Hall of Respite, multiple people gather around the waters to listen to the bards, a place for spreading joy.

Suddenly Mydei realized why they were here, Castorice loved spending her time here.

In fact, she was right where Mydei thought she would be, in the gazebo, looking into the distance, a mingle of clouds, rainbows and mountains extending themselves into the faraway abyss.

“Castorice, I’m glad I found you here”

“Greetings Lord Phainon, you are here to inquire about Lord Mydei, correct?” At this point Mydei isn’t surprised that she knows, every Chrysos Heir is probably aware of his predicament right now.

“Yes, precisely. I’m guessing that you know nothing either, right?” Phainon said, dejected, he already knew talking with her was a waste, but he didn’t have that many people he could confide in right now.

“Lady Trianne told me what happened yesterday. Unfortunately, I haven’t seen Lord Mydei since the day we three spent our time together in the baths. I’m sorry I am unable to be of any help” Castorice looked at the ground, sad that she couldn’t help Phainon more, that she couldn’t do anything for Mydei.

“There’s no need to apologize Castorice, nobody knows what happened with Mydei. I just thought it wouldn’t hurt to ask” Phainon said with a smile that didn’t quite reach his eyes.

“You are right, but I wish I could do something more for you. Lady Aglaea told me not to speak of it publicly, which leaves me with little option more than looking for him in the outskirts of the city”

She looked down again in defeat, and Mydei haven’t felt this guilty in a while.  All his friends were worried and looking for him.

And he couldn’t do anything about it.

Mydei instinctively let out a sad wail that sounded like someone had kicked a Chimera, the sound came out of nowhere and was so off putting that he cut himself off before it could finish.

It immediately caught both Phainon and Castorice attention though, both were looking down at him.

“Is this…a new friend of yours Lord Phainon?” She looked down at him, sadness still visible on her eyes accompanied with a small smile “Yes, I picked him up not long ago, he’s been with me since then” Phainon looked at him fondly “I named him Meowdei”

Castorice fell into a deep silence.

“…”

Phainon did as well.

“…”

“I know Lord Mydei is important to you Lord Phainon, but this might not be a healthy coping mechanism”

Phainon looked at her, eyes big as saucers “Huh? W-wait Castorice is not like you think, he simply just looks like Mydei! I swear look!” Then Phainon abruptly picked him up against his will, both hands under Mydei’s tiny front legs holding him in front of Castorice.

His awoos of complaint weren’t taken into consideration.

“Look! You know he looks exactly like him, eyes and all! And you know Mydei runs Fig Stew is so yummy, it’s exactly the same Chimera! Please Castorice, you see my vision, right?”

By Nikador why does Phainon sound like an actual kicked Chimera now? He’s sure if he could turn around and saw him, he would look like one too.

Castorice stayed silent, looking at Mydei from top to bottom

“…Yes, I must admit that taking in consideration all of the facts, he indeed looks like Lord Mydei”

This again, it seems like he can’t fight the Chimera allegations.

He really wishes he could.

“See! I knew you’d see my vision Castorice” Phainon said giggly, now placing Mydei back on the floor.

Castorice let out a sigh, at least the previous tension had disappeared, he could thank Phainon for that.

“I’ll keep looking for Lord Mydei. If anything comes up, I’ll make sure to send you a message right away”

“Thank you Castorice, I appreciate it immensely”

Phainon was about to say goodbye before Castorice stopped him.

“Just an idea…”

“What is it Castorice?”

“I heard from Lady Aglaea that Lady Cipher would be back soon or at least will have to. Lady Aglaea is calling out for her” Mydei scarcely sees Cipher, he can count the amounts of time he had the displeasure to see her with one hand. The fact that Aglaea is trying to get her, another demigod, to come to Okhema where she doesn’t want to ever come speaks volumes about the situation.

What a mess.

“She will help us find Lord Mydei…allegedly”

Phainon laughs, he knows perfectly that dealing with Cipher requires a ridiculous amount of treasure, and if it’s not up to her satisfaction she won’t lift a finger.

Mydei just realized that Aglaea is going to give Cipher who knows how much money just to find him.

He mentally growls, he owes Aglaea so much already, he doesn’t wish to bother her anymore.

Then it struck him, if this was indeed a trick played by a follower of Zagreus, then he just needed to find Cipher himself, she sees past the trick and fix him.

Unless she deems it hilarious and won’t do anything about it.

…

He won’t let that happen.

“I’ll keep it in mind then, thank you greatly Castorice”

Phainon and Castorice had a brief goodbye, then Phainon brough him back to the Marmoreal Palance, sharing his theories along the way as they walked “He couldn’t just disappear from Amphoreus right?” Phainon said, brows furrowed in deep thinking.

There was no way Mydei could get even close to getting out of Amphoreus, Phainon is just saying things.

Then absolute silence, followed by a whisper “no, that’s dumb”.

Glad they agree at least.

A few beats later Phainon comes out with another theory “Ok but what if, listen, what if Mydei found a way to ignore Aglaea’s treads and he’s hiding somewhere in Okhema…?” He doesn’t sound convinced, as he should because that theory is absolutely idiotic.

Another whisper “Maybe not…he wouldn’t do that”

And he has no way of doing that! Nobody can get away from Aglaea without her noticing first.

They go like that, casually walking all around Okhema, Phainon sharing his thoughts with him, each one made no sense whatsoever and Mydei was frankly just tired of hearing him by that point.

No sign of the Zagreus follower either.

This is going to take time.

In the end they end up in the entrance of the Marmoreal Palace and sat down on one of the benches nearby, both feeling equality defeated.

Phainon looked at the bright blue sky al let out a heavy sigh “Whatever shall I do…” He looked back to look at Mydei, visible sadness in his eyes. Gone was the Deliverer who put out a front to ease everyone’s worries “At least you are here to keep me company for now…”

Phainon slowly caressed his fur atop of his head, the sadness never left his eyes.

This nonsense was tearing not only his life apart but also his friends, his family.

Mydei felt a deep buried anger bubbling up, he will end this foolishness, nobody messes with his family, nobody has the right to tear it apart once again, nobody-

Mydei stopped on his tracks once Phainon suddenly received a sting of messages coming from his teleslate.

Phainon quickly stopped his petting session to look at his teleslate, surprised marred his face once he saw the screen, follow by a frown that disappeared as quickly as it came “Aglaea wants to see me” he said as he pocketed his device.

What did Aglaea want from Phainon now? He hadn’t spoken to anybody about Mydei (outside of well, Mydei himself) so what prompted the sudden visit?

While he was thinking Phainon suddenly had a bright smile while looking down at him “Wanna race me there?”

What.

Before Mydei could process what Phainon just utter, the man himself was already running towards the baths.

Does this man have no honor?!

Mydei followed behind me with the sheer speed of a determined Chimera.

Which wasn’t much, but it sure was quite a spectacle to everyone in the area who saw their hero running around getting chased down by a bright orange Chimera in the middle of the Lucid Hour.

He couldn’t keep up with Phainon anymore, his short legs wouldn’t allow it.

Despite the contest not being entirely fair and Mydei not even agreeing to it in the first place, he had to admit that it was bringing him back to their silly competitions.

Mydei missed it, he misses this a lot.

It’s barely been two days, but his life has become a wreck. All his friends are looking for him worriedly while he’s just standing there watching everything unfolding, unable to speak, to express, he has lost his humanity, but for this spare moment, even if it doesn’t last even a minute, just for now he can be Mydei, not the Crown Prince, not a Chrysos Heir, not a Chimera, just Mydei.

Mydei reaches the finish line, Phainon awaiting there for him, not tired at all. On the other hand, Mydei was practically panting, this new body of his was way too weak.

For a second he ponders if he should just train in this form, but doing so would also accept that this is him as well, and he’s not a damned Chimera.

“You did great! I didn’t know Chimeras could run that fast” They don’t.

“Let’s go up, shall we?”

They both rode the elevator to the Hero’s Bath, the scene unfolding in front of them was very familiar, one he has seen a multitude of times.

Aglaea stands before them, her stance as immaculate as ever, her gaze blind and all seeing at the same time watches over them, her entire being exuding the aura of a demigod she very much was.

“You are here, Phainon” a pause, a slight rise of an eyebrow “The Chimera from before” not a question, but a statement.

“Yes, he’s just tagging along with me” A smile, like the ones he always gives, but not all of them are true “What is that you from me Aglaea?” he was direct, straight to the point, not letting her derail the conversation to somewhere unnecessary, Phainon doesn’t have the time. He knows she’s about to send him on a mission, she wants him distracted, to not think too much about Mydei, but how could he not?

“There have been recent sightings of Titankin near the southwest borders of Okhema, I would like you to get rid of them before they reach the houses situated at edge of the Holy City”

Phainon bob his head in understanding, he knows Aglaea hasn’t finish speaking

“Normally this would be a mission for two but…”  Mydei is gone.

He knows.

Phainon gets sent to these kinds of mission with Mydei often, while they usually compete how much they could kill on their own, they also work extremely well together as a team.

Too many weak enemies that they could take on their own? Why not take both to make it swifter?

A powerful opponent that could pose a threat? Why not take both to fish it without a hitch?

“I ask of you to be-“

“Twice as careful, I get it” Phainon interrupted her, he never does. Aglaea deserves respect, but he can’t help feeling bothered at her request.

She paid it no mind, as if she knew how Phainon felt.

She probably does.

“Be safe Phainon, I don’t think it will be necessary, but if something happens just get in range of my threads and I’ll send reinforcements as quickly as possible”

“Thank you Aglaea, I’ll take my leave now”  

Phainon didn’t spare a second more there, he made sure Meowdei was following him, taking the elevator down.

The Chimera wasn’t the most talkative per se, but he was quieter than usual, Phainon didn’t bother to fill in the silence either.

They both went back to his house. Phainon quickly grabbed everything he needed for his expedition, some food, water, it was a few hours by foot, so he needed those.

He was rapidly gathering his items, there was no reason to be this hasty, if it was urgent Aglaea would have said so, there was no imminent danger coming, it was a prevention.

So, there was no need to be this fast, but Phainon couldn’t help it.

This mission was a distraction, it was meant to be a break, but it did nothing but fan the flames of his deep-rooted worry.

What if Mydei comes back and he isn’t there? What if he needs help? What if a clue of his whereabouts presents itself but he isn’t there to see it?

Phainon collects his sword, he makes sure it’s polished and ready to go, he can’t let the poor people of the outskirts alone either, they are surely living in fear right now. Knowing that there are roaming Titankin nearby is not a pleasant thought before bed.

Phainon lets out a sigh as he fixes his armor in place, he counts his rations, adding a bit more in case it drags more than a day (he really hopes it doesn’t).

But maybe, just maybe, Mydei is out there on the outskirts for whatever reason? It’s just wishful thinking, he knows, but it will keep him going, another reason to go even if it is just for a quick check.

Once he was done and ready to go, he went to the door only to notice that Meowdei was going out with him “Oh no, you are staying home” He saw the Chimera doing a scowl, sheesh he doesn’t think he ever saw a Chimera look so offended before.

He grabbed the animal only to be met with protest, tiny limbs sprawling around trying to scratch him, an audible awoo of protest  “Listen, you can’t go with me. I can’t guarantee your safety” 

Phainon put Meowdei on his bed “I’ll come back later today” he thought it for a second “maybe tomorrow” he added, he really can’t be sure without being there to assess the situation “I also give you permission to eat the food that’s on the tabletop on the kitchen, I know you can reach it”

If it takes longer than usual, he might need to text Castorice and ask her to take care of the Chimera, the food thats on the tabletop would not be enough.

Meowdei, however, wasn’t convinced at all. He still looked offended, as if he was a great warrior that just got denied being on the battlefield.

Phainon give him a few pats on the head and then took a step backwards, and another, and another…when he noticed the Chimera wasn’t actually trying to follow him, he turned around and went to the door.

“I’ll come as soon as possible” He opened it and went outside; he closed the door but not entirely, he looked at Meowdei who was now near the door looking at him “Please don’t hate me” he said as he closed the door, he swears the scowl turned into a pout a moment before he closed the door.

It might be a long day today.

Mydei watched as Phainon closed the door, a warrior who got denied access to the battlefield…how low has he sunk.

As much as it hurt, there was truth to Phainon’s words, he couldn’t simply head into the battle in this weakened state, he would surely die. He’s nothing but cannon fodder right now.

Mydei, however, had an idea that might help his case.

Now, where does Phainon stores his papers and quills…

Mydei looked around the house for what it seemed hours, piles of fake relics, useless trinkets, stone tablets…where in the world does Phainon keeps his scrolls?!

He looked everywhere only to come up with nothing.

In the end Mydei got tired of looking and threw himself on the makeshift bed that Phainon had made for him the previous night, he was slowly closing his eyes, ready for a quick nap before he noticed a box underneath the bed.

His eyes opened quickly, he went after the box, pushing it with his big head until it was finally out.

Now that the box was illuminated by the light of Kephale, he could clearly see a concerning number of scrolls inside the box, all pushed inside the box without much thought, some weren’t even closed.

Does Phainon not take good care of his stuff?

He took a bunch of them out and into the floor, he looked around to see if he had any empty ones, but all the scrolls he brought out were full.

Dromas Herakle’s Twelve Trials nonsense Chimera’s Work Handbook (2nd edition) really? Amphoreus’ Calendar why does he even need this? Analysis of Nikador’s Romantic Histories huh?! That made Mydei pause for a second, he isn’t thoroughly reading any of the scrolls, he’s merely assessing if they are written or not already.

Why in the world would Phainon have a scroll depicting Nikador’s love life?

Ignoring that Mydei continued, Dairy of a Kremnoan Sergeant why would he even have this, Kings of Kremnos…

…

How did he even get his hands on this.

It wasn’t all of them, the more he took out of the box the more scrolls about Kremnos would appear, about the culture, their traditions, their way of life, some were nonsense, some were more…private works.

Mydei opted to ignore all of it, for his own sanity.

Then he read the most dreadful title he’s ever laid eyes on From rivals to lovers in a vaguely familiar handwriting, followed by a sun and a moon drawing.

He felt his heart sank, this is not what he thinks it is, is it? It doesn’t seem like a distributed work, the ink is a little off in some places, there’s a bit of ink that was spilled in the corner, it doesn’t look at all like it was made with the intention to sell.

A private work.

The sun was undoubtedly Phainon, and the moon…

Mydei didn’t want to think about it, this was most likely linked to Phainon’s true love. He doesn’t wish to intrude in such matters, so he pushed the scroll to the side…it seemed quite long too.

He needs to find an empty scroll.

Mydei eventually stopped reading the titles, merely opening the scrolls to see if it had text or not.

It took some time, but he finally found an empty one, of course they were at the very end of the damned box.

Now he just needed to open it properly on the floor and…

He looked around, scrolls were everywhere, there was practically not a place on the ground where there wasn’t a scroll already.

…He’ll clean up later.

Mydei made some space by moving a few scrolls out of the way, making sure to not break them in the process.

On his lookout for the scroll, he had already found the quill he needed to write and kept it nearby.

Now he only needed to write a letter explaining everything, then it will all fix itself.

But here comes the tricky part, he has no opposite thumbs, let alone any fingers.

So, he has to do this with his mouth, easier said than done, his bite wasn’t strong enough to grab it from the hilt, so he had to grab the pen on its side without being able to see exactly what he was writing.

It took very long time to finally finish writing the first two words “I have” and when Mydei went to look at it, it was, well, it looked like a scribble, he couldn’t make up a single word.

So, he tried again only for it to end up being even more indecipherable than the previous one.

“Come on, it can’t be this hard”  he said out loud to no one.

Mydei tried and tried again to no avail, he just couldn't make up a single understandable word.

So, he tried the very next best thing, drawing.

He tried to draw himself turning into a Chimera, basic but brilliant, the problem was the execution, however.

Mydei was very much an artist, his silly Chimera animations would reach thousands of views, a little hobby of his that he partakes any moment he has some spare time.

Phainon had mention it before, but he really does bear resemblance to the Chimera he uses to represents himself in his videos…don’t tell him the Zagreus follower though it funny to just turn it into reality…

Forgetting all that, he did his best to draw himself followed by an arrow pointing at a Chimera.

This would get the point across.

There is no chance that a random Chimera (that has the same eyes and Mydei) suddenly shows up after Mydei mysteriously goes missing then makes a very specific drawing of Mydei with a pointing arrow to a Chimera that looks exactly like the same Chimera that did the drawing in the first place.

It would do the trick, it had to.

But it wouldn’t, he thought he could rely on not looking at it and let memory do its job but it looked like a toddler just found his father’s scroll and started scribbling all over.

He seriously underestimated his ability to draw with his mouth, blind.

Mydei spit out the quill, he’s tired.

The room was still a mess, but he was sleepy, he’s pretty sure is still not even the Parting hour yet but he feels like when he comes back from a long mission and gets to crash on his bed.

Mydei does exactly that, crashes on Phainon’s bed, not in the makeshift one, he feels like he needs all the space he can get at the moment.

It was indeed huge, not just for his Chimera form, it wasn’t a bed meant for one person, their accommodations as Chrysos Heir’s brought its perks and having a moderately big house and good furniture was one of them.

He didn’t make it into the middle of the bed, he jumped over on it and that seemed enough to drain away the little energy he had left.

He would sleep for just a moment, he would clean everything afterwards just, let him rest for a second…a quick nap…

…

Phainon made his way to the outskirts, the trip there was uneventful, other than citizens of Okhema wishing him good luck on his new quest there wasn’t much more to mention, more so since this was a mission so close home.

When he reached the tiny set of houses situated at the southwest corner of Okhema the citizens came over to him pleading for assistance.

He got a lot of complaints all at the same time.

“Please Lord Phainon, my daughter cannot go play outside the house anymore with those monsters roaming around!”

“Those monsters approached me while I was hunting and scared me to death, get rid of them already!”

“Oh Chrysos Heir, please hear our plea! I haven’t been able to rest properly the past few days because of them!”

 The tension was palpable, everyone was on their wits end about the situation, nobody here was suited for fighting.

Hence why Phainon is here.

“Ok, ok. Let’s all calm down, shall we?” Everyone suddenly shut up, eyes fully on Phainon “Please tell me exactly where you saw them, and if you can which weapons they used”

Everyone came together to tell him what’s been happening the past few days, roaming Titankin moving in the forest, never near the houses, but close enough to generate panic.

Phainon noted on his head every location where Titankin were seen, and it pretty much was all over the place, they were practically surrounded.

It will indeed be a long day.

Once he collected enough information, he set himself into the forest and began his hunt.

It didn’t take long to find the first Titankin, a spawn of Nikador, simply sitting idle.

He strikes him down without mercy.

That alerted the nearby Titankin who saw their comrade being turned to dust in the span of a second.

At least it made his job easier, not having to look after all of them.

He slayed his enemies left and right, not caring to grant them a merciless kill, just getting the job done.

There were, frankly, a lot. Not too many as if he actually needed somebody else to help him beat them, but enough for his mind to remind him of Mydei’s absence and very much missed assistance.

(If he defeated the next Titankin he saw with more force than usual it was just for him to know)

If Mydei were here, they could’ve had their usual competitions, who kill more or maybe who could kill the fastest.

He put down an Furiae Troupe without much mind, his thoughts full of Mydei.

By Kephale it hasn’t been two full days, and he already missed him so much.

Phainon charged in and slayed an Archer that has been annoying him for a while.

He really can’t help it, Mydei wasn’t gone for a mission, he was seriously gone, like it was nothing!

A Philosopher meet the end of his sword.

Mydei, where have you gone to?

…

Every Titankin felt swiftly one after the other, most of them were separated which made the fight relatively easier, albeit still tiring.

Phainon spent hours tracking them down and killing each and every one of them.

He was sure that he had dealt with all of them when he felt something coming after him, he barely dodged an arrow aimed at his head.

It managed to cut his cheek, he felt a sting sensation followed by golden blood that started to pour out of the wound.

Now fully turning around Phainon could see that he had left the big guns for last.

A Furiae Preaetor followed by two Warriors, an Archer and a Philospher were standing in front of him.

Phainon took on the challenge, he didn’t waste time whatsoever and lunged at the Archer with incredible speed, he sweeps his sword aiming at the bow, he put it out its hands.

The Archer barely could register the action before Phainon struck it down in the middle of its body, making the Titankin crumble into dust.

The Furiae Preaetor wouldn’t let that slide, it didn’t waste a second to strike his massive sword against Phainon which had more than enough time to parry it making the giant Titankin lose its stance momentarily allowing Phainon some time to kill the Philosofer before it could do anything.

Now it was just Phainon against the Preaetor and the Warriors.

The giant Titankin stricked again with renown strength, almost scrapping Phainon who dodged the attack and landed a blow right on the Titankin’s chest, the Preaetor didn’t bulge however, and he continued his attack.

Another miss from the Preaetor, but an opportunity for the Warrior beside it.

The lesser Titankin managed to grab Phainon’s sword, halting his action while another Warrior tried to go after Phainon now that he was stuck in place. 

Phainon gathered all the strength he had to overpower the Titankin who held his sword, broking his arm completely, his sword now free meet the approaching Titankin chest who crumbled into nothingness.

He took care of the Titankin with the missing hand just as quickly, only to realize that the Preaetor was charging its attack.

This is where Mydei would’ve surely come in handy, he thought he and Phainon would take the charge stance to their advantage, with two people coming from either side it was usually a fair end to an attack that would be devastating otherwise.

Mydei wasn’t here, however, so he needed to improvise.

It’s not like he hasn’t fought Furiae Preaetors alone, but it certainly is easier when he’s with his rival.

He’ll just have to apply double the force to bring it down, easy right?

Phainon came from behind to strike it on its back, usually Mydei would deal the damage from the front. In the odd case that they hadn’t managed to beat it down before it stopped charging then the damage would go to Mydei (even if Phainon had protested multiple times) to “minimize injuries” as if his are less important that Phainon’s…

Not that it ever happened…

Right at this moment however, Phainon did his best to beat the giant, his sword was stuck on the Titankin’s back and he did his best to bury it deeper.

Phainon started to see the body filled with cracks, but it wasn’t enough, the Furiae ended his charge, and he was still stuck behind the creature.

He needs to get out, now.

Phainon pulled out the sword swiftly, he saw how the Titankin meant to grab him with one hand, so he jumped off, but that seemed to be a trap, the usual slow Titankin suddenly did a 160 and unleashed his attack upon Phainon leaving little room to escape.

For a second he thought he miraculously managed to dodge the attack before he felt his left side burn terribly, warm golden blood was spilling from his side. Not a mortal wound but nothing he should scoff at.

The Furiae didn’t look any better though, his previous attack dealt a considerable amount of damage, he was full of cracks all over his body, it took two measly strikes to finally put it down.

Phainon really wanted to sit down but he knew if he did that, he wouldn’t be able to stand up.

He needed medical attention as soon as possible.

The nearest set of houses wasn’t far, in fact the Titankin were alarmingly close to it now that he properly assessed the situation, they were probably about to attack at any second.

Phainon cut part of his cape and bandaged his wound as best as he could with it, and went back, it wasn’t more than ten-minute walk there, he will takt to Aglaea about it later.

When he arrived the people hurriedly came to his side and called for their local doctor, he was laid down on bed and had him properly treated and bandaged.

Less than 20 minutes later he was already up ready to go back home.

“But sir you are injured!” Plead the kind man that let him use his house to rest.

“The doctor said you should rest for at least a night. It’s already Curtain-Fall Hour, there’s no need to rush, you can stay here for the night” The man’s wife affirmed.

“I’ll be fine. Do not worry, the Chrysos Heirs are tougher than your regular human” he said offering a smile trying to convince this poor family to let him go.

Neither of them was convinced “We know we can’t make you stay Lord Phainon but at least take this food and medicine for the way home”

The man brough up a few loaves of breads, a canteen of water and some bandages for him, but Phainon couldn’t accept them, living in the outskirts of Okhema was hard as it was, he wouldn’t dare take anything more from them.

“I do appreciate your kindness but there’s no need, I came prepared with enough food and water as well as medical supplies” He lied on the last part, it kind of flew over his head since he’s so used to going out on these missions with Mydei and not often he came out injured so gravely.

“But my Lord…” They seemed sad they couldn’t provide for him, but Phainon would soon throw himself at a stampede of Dromas before taking from the poor.

“Let’s do the following then, I’ll take half a loaf of bread and in exchange I want you all to continue to live peacefully here, does that sound good?”

They both look at each other, still not looking quite convinced but seemingly understanding the situation “Very well, but please take care on your way home”

“Will do, no problem” He took half a loaf of bread as he promised, he knew they wouldn’t accept is he just went completely empty handed as much as he wished he could.

He ate it on his way back, it was crunchy on the outside and poofy on the inside, completely perfect bread if you would ask Phainon, nothing like the ones he would eat back at Aedes Elysiae.

He made his way home, his wounds opened on the track back, but he managed to stop the bleeding by cutting some more of his clothes (Aglaea wouldn’t be happy at all about it, but she would understand).

By the time he arrived it was around the Curtain-Fall Hour third quint and nobody was outside of their homes besides a few people that loved to stay awake while everyone sleeps.

Thankfully nobody paid him any attention and was able to reach his house without major fanfare.

He opened the door, nothing seemed out of place until he went to his bedroom only to find an absolute mess on the floor, all the scrolls he stored under his bed were all over the floor alongside the storge box that was on its side.

Did someone break in? It wasn’t that common, but it wasn’t out of the question either but before he could think about it further, he remembered something more important.

Meowdei-

Phainon quickly moved around the house, checking for the Chimera but couldn’t find him anywhere, not in the living room, or the kitchen, in the bathroom, on the balcony, in his bedroom again-

Did someone really break into his house to steal a bunch of papers and a Chimera? Who in the world would-

His frantic thoughts came to a halt as he heard the soft snores of a tiny creature coming from his bed, he hadn’t noticed in his panic that the little animal was quietly sleeping at the edge of the bed, it kind of blended in with the orange blanket he had been using these days.

He made a mental note to change it to the usual blue ones he had tomorrow.

Phainon let out groan, the adrenaline he just felt dissipating from his body making him notice how tired he was.

Upton further thinking, nothing in his house was amiss besides the scrolls, the little Chimera probably thought it would be funny to play around with them, he took 10 years away from Phainon’s lifespan by scare alone instead.

Now that he was sure that Meowdei was fine, he made his way to his bathroom where he took off the top of his clothes and cleaned his wound again, disinfected it as well as applied new bandages.

He looked at himself in the mirror and noticed how tired he was, eyebags quite visible on his face, his hair was a mess, he also forgot about the wound on his cheek.

He let out a sigh, he probably had to get that looked at well, but today was a long day and he was deadly tired.

Phainon made his way to his bedroom and put the curtains down to dim down the light from Kephale’s Dawn Device.

The moment he got to his bed he dropped himself on it, making sure not to do so on the side of his wound, also being careful not to wake up the sleeping Chimera.

Not even a minute after his back hit the bed, he was out like a light.

Mydei wasn’t sure how long he had been sleeping before he felt the bed weight shifting, for a second, he thought about keeping on sleeping but he also wanted to make sure that Phainon was alright.

Mydei begrudgingly opened his eyes only to find Phainon half-naked again, already sleeping apparently, the fool didn’t even bother taking his boots off! And-

He was injured, great, Phainon couldn’t even keep himself safe in his absence.

Mydei sighed -or did the equivalent of sighing in Chimera language- and approached the man, at least it looked like it was properly taken care of.

He couldn’t see the rest of his body properly unless he moved to the other side, so he did and fortunately Phainon didn’t seem injured besides a few scratches here and there.

Good, Mydei though as his eyes dropped dangerously low, how come he’s still sleepy if he has been sleeping for hours now?

He couldn’t help it and closed his eyes unconsciously moving towards warmth, he ended up curling close to Phainon’s side and he was out like a light as quickly as he closed his eyes.

Chapter End Notes

Fun fact! The Mydei drawing was made by doing exactly as the fanifc states, just grabbing the pen on the sides with my mouth, I do not recommend it.

Mydei is so eepy, I nerfed you so much my king, I’m so sorry.

Chapter Notes

Oh wow new chapter would you look at that. (I updated some of the tags btw)

This fic will probably be like...5 chapters? It depends on a few things but around that leng maybe one chapter more I dunno.
I also hope I can upload the next chapter before 3.4 drops, you know, before we are all emotionally destroyed.

Anyways enjoy.

Phainon woke up to warmth on his side, in his drowsiness he thought that his wound might’ve just reopened.

He quickly opened his eyes and looked to his right where the warmth was coming from, but he quickly realized it wasn’t his injured side, and the warmth wasn’t his blood spilling out of him.

Meowdei was peacefully sleeping on his right side, and his injury was the same as he left it the night before.

Phainon let out a sigh of relief, he would still have to tend it for the next few days, Hyacine will not be around for another week or so, her miraculous healing was sorely missed already.  

In the silence of his home, Phainon could hear Meowdei snoring, the little sounds he made while he was curled up next to him did nothing but fuel the cuteness aggression he always felt whenever the Chimera was near him.

This was definitely a sight that could warm any heart. A Chimera? Cute. A sleeping snoring Chimera? Utterly adorable. A sleeping snoring Chimera that was cuddling next to Phainon right now? Could kill from diabetes.

Phainon suddenly felt an urge to go to the bathroom, but he wouldn’t dare wake up the sleepy tiny friend beside him, he probably needed the rest after making an absolute mess in his bedroom yesterday, that little rascal.

Phainon stayed there, quiet for a few minutes looking at the ceiling before Meowdei finally stirred awake, the Chimera let out a sleepy yawn, showing his sharp teeth as he opened his mouth.

“Good morning” Phainon greeted him, that however, seemed to alert the Chimera that was now fully awake “Sorry, did I startle you? It wasn’t my intention”

He scratched the Chimera below the chin as an apology and by the looks of it he loved it, letting himself relax at Phainon’s gentle caress.

Phainon took it as a chance to go ahead and scratch the ears as well, to his surprise the little creature moved his head towards Phainon’s hand, seemingly eager for more pets and…was that a purring he was hearing? Phainon couldn’t be more pleased about it.

It’s been a while since he had a pet. Well, he technically never did, just the family farm animals they had back when he was a kid. Maybe it did if you could count a sheep as pet?

It wasn’t like Chimeras were exactly pets either, they were intelligent creatures with their own autonomy, to a certain degree at least…

A shame only a few could actually understand them, Phainon really wishes he could know what his little friend was saying.

Suddenly the purring abruptly ended, so Phainon stopped his caresses as well.

Meowdei was completely still, as if in shock.

Phainon tried touching it, but it was as if he was a statue, completely still

“W-what’s wrong!? Did I accidentally hurt you…somehow?” Phainon didn’t know what was happening, the sudden change couldn’t be anything good by any means.

“Please, what’s wrong? Tell me, I mean I know you can’t really tell me, I meant like, just, I-”

He was starting to mix his words in his panic, just what is he supposed to do in a situation like this?!

The Chimera remained still and before Phainon could stand up and go out to look for help, Meowdei looked at him and…suddenly calmed down.

His body went lax, his tail was slowly moving side to side, completely normal, as if nothing just happened.

Oh, thank Kephale, he’s fine, he thinks?

Phainon isn’t exactly sure.

Gods what is he doing? He’s getting worked up by such small things, Mydei’s disappearance is driving him insane, he doesn’t know how much more his heart can take it.

He can’t help but see Mydei in the Chimera’s eyes, he really is starting to lose it.

Phainon let himself drop back into bed as he let out the biggest sigh he ever made.

A moment after his back hit the bed, Meowdei suddenly was back beside him, nuzzling on his side, as if apologizing.

Phainon was frankly scared of touching the Chimera again, so he abstained from doing so, but the animal was persistent and suddenly he jumped atop Phainon’s chest and looked directly at him.

His eyes were frowning, they looked exactly like sunshine, very much like Mydei’s, a carbon copy.

Phainon stared at them entranced, those were the eyes he loved very dearly. The eyes of the man he loved.

Phainon felt a knot forming on his throat.

Slowly Phainon lifted his hand, very carefully he approached the Chimera, and placed his hand beside his check.

Just like before he melted into the touch.

Phainon was more careful now however, just letting Meowdei do whatever he wishes.

“You know, I realize now I haven’t told you anything about him, huh?” The Chimera went still for a second before continuing his nuzzling, urging him to continue.

Phainon let out a little chuckle “Mydei, my friend, he’s, well…” He didn’t know how to put it into words; he had never shared his thoughts about Mydei with anyone before.

He guessed talking about them with a Chimera couldn’t hurt but it still did not make the words come out easily.

“Frankly? Most people think of Mydei as a brute, cold man, but he’s nothing like that at all! He’s actually really sweet person oh and also very powerful. For example, when we first meet, we fought for 10 days and 10 nights, can you believe that?” He couldn’t help but smile at the memory.

Meowdei was attentively looking at him now, eyes full of curiosity.

“Then he goes and does the sweetest of things, like cooking for the Chrysos Heirs, playing with the kids…He’s recently been taking care of a Dromas too, I think Mydei loves him dearly” The more he thought about Mydei’s incredible qualities, the more he felt his grin widen “He even made food just for me so I can keep it in my fridge, I guess at this point you know I’m not that good at cooking…”

A little huff came out of Meowdei, it was utterly adorable.

“I really look up to him and, well…I also…” Now he’s getting all shy, he can’t believe he’s telling this to a Chimera.

…

Scratch that he’s not confessing in front of Meowdei, it almost feels like he’s talking to the man himself and he’s nowhere near ready to confess to him.

“Never mind, all you need to know is that Mydei is a wonderful person, no matter what anyone says”

He petted the Chimera a few more times, Phainon was purposely avoiding eye contact the past few sentences, now that he looks back at Meowdei, his expression is unreadable.

“Let’s get ready for the day head, yeah?”

Phainon put the Chimera aside and step out of the bed.

Only to slip on an opened scroll and fall down on his injured side.

Oh yeah, he forgot about that.

And blood was spurting out of his injury now.

…He needs to have a talk with Meowdei.

Phainon had really uttered all those sweet things about him so openly, so full of joy.

Mydei wondered if he could do the same for Phainon.

He guesses he could.

Mydei could say to him how Phainon was like the first rays of sunshine on a cold morning, Mydei could say that he was like the sweetest pomegranate juice mixed with milk, Mydei could say that he was like a relentless blade that could best even the fiercest of enemies.

…

No, he guesses he can’t, Mydei doesn’t think about Phainon the same way that Phainon thinks about Mydei.

It was all a losing battle.

Phainon had already moved him aside, the perfect moment already lost to them.

Then a moment later Mydei saw how Phainon gracefully slip and fall to the ground.

It was amusing for a good second before he remembered his friend was genuinely injured from the day before.

Mydei swiftly jumped out of bed and tried to push Phainon’s back with his head, urging him to stand.

“Hey, I’m fine, I’m fine. I’ll check on it right now, don’t worry” Mydei received a gentle chin scratch, then Phainon stood up and went to the bathroom.

Mydei was now alone before the mess of his own creation.

Phainon was stupid for not checking beforehand where he was going, but it was also his fault for not cleaning up after making a mess.

Mydei sighed, the day had barely started.

Phainon eventually came out of the bathroom, new bandages and all, by then Mydei had managed to move a decent number of scrolls back into the box.

He still had to listen to Phainon scolding him about not leaving things on the ground, as if he were a child.

Mydei was going to clean it up mind you, he was just…real sleepy yesterday…

And always.

Why did Chimeras need to sleep so much?

In the end Phainon deemed it necessary to ban him from using scrolls and put the box on the highest shelf of his house so that Mydei couldn’t reach it.

There goes his plan of getting better at writing.

Great, what is he supposed to do now?

He cannot find the one that cursed him, and he is not even allowed to write things down, what else can he-

Then it struck him.

Phainon’s teleslate! He can borrow it for a second, type a quick message.

Phainon was busy making breakfast, or well, more accurately taking refrigerated food out of the fridge, and his teleslate was on the table all alone.

Now is his chance.

Mydei swiftly jumped on the kitchen chair, then to the table and used his paw to turn on the teleslate and then!

Face recognition block.

Damn it, passcode it is.

Unfortunately, Phainon has never shared his teleslate passcode with him.

So…Phainon’s birthday? He typed it out with much effort; his paws were too big and were pressing more than one number when he tried to press them.

In the end the passcode was incorrect, was it because Phainon’s birthday wasn’t the code or because of his big paws Mydei doesn’t know.

He was in the middle of taping another code when Phainon caught him in the act.

“Oh? You want to play on the teleslate? I’ll let you but only for limited time, extended use might fry your brain”

Then Phainon got the teleslate, put on the password and left it in front of Mydei.

???

Was it going to be that easy?

Of course it wasn’t.

He quickly made his way to the Garden of Life, where he saw the orange fur he missed so much

“Meowdei you are here!” He grabbed the Chimera that was looking in the opposite direction, only to realize it wasn’t Mydei once he turned it around, no it wasn’t his dear companion

The chimera let out a confused aww? As it tilted its head, eyes a deep red, clearly not Meowdei’s.

Phainon put them back on the ground apologetically “I’m sorry little one, I confused you with another friend of mine”

He did the same exact thing with another two Chimeras that look identical to Meowdei but came out disappointed every time, none of them had the same blazing golden eyes as the Chimera he has grown to love so much.

It was a dead end, Meowdei wasn’t here.

Phainon had half a mind to contact Aglaea to ask her about Meowdei, but she was busy as she was right now, he couldn’t dream of bothering her at the moment.

What will he do now?

Just why did this keep happening to him?

Has he done something wrong in his previous life to be deserving of such punishment? For Meowdei to leave just as Mydei did?

Looking at the time he realized it was already almost the end of the Action Hour, meaning the Chartonus was about to close shop for the day.

He left Chartonus waiting the whole day to give him the signet ring…

It was a day he was looking forward to for a while, even before Mydei went missing.

They fought so hard to get that ring back, to get it back to Mydei…

Phainon couldn’t help but feel hollow now, both old and new constant in his life now missing, there was no companion that would follow him back home and nobody to return the signet ring to.

Yet he still made his way back to the Marketplace in a hurry, the first quint of the Paring Hour had already started once he reached the smithy, almost out of breath.

“Phainon is here” Chartonus went and looked for the signet ring, talking as he did so “Tired you look, resting soon you should”

“I know” he said almost out of breath “I know”

“Running here you shouldn’t, wait for you I would’ve” oh, no, no, no, he troubles Chartonus enough with his requests “No, Chartonus, you should close shop in time no need to wait for me”

By now, Chartonus had made his way back, now with the signet ring in hand

“Signet Ring restoration is done, give it to Crown Prince you can” Chartonus lend him the ring, it was such a small item, yet it carried so much weight.

“Thank you Chartonus, I could never repay you enough for this”

“Pay me you have already. No need for further payment I have”

“Still, this is precious work you have done for me” He looks down at the Signet Ring thinking back to Mydei.

“I haven’t told you this but, I originally thought of letting you hold onto this ring until the right time, so you could give it to him but…I think I changed my mind, I will give it to him personally” Someday, when Mydei is back, someday when they would reunite, someday…

…

“Wise decision you have taken. Wishing you good luck I do”

“Thank you Chartonus, for everything, really sorry for making you wait”

“Problem is not, off you go Phainon”

After bidding farewell to Chartonus and safeguarding the ring, he was painfully reminded of the absence of his new friend.

Phainon sat down on one of the nearby benches, looking up at Kephale’s Dawn Device, wondering what to do.

He ignored the buzzling teleslate in his pocket, trying to find some peace.

The streets were starting to empty, most shops were already closed or in the process of doing so, leaving little reason for the citizens of Okhema to linger.

He took a few breaths, in and out, he let time pass him by.

Phainon hadn’t even noticed it was Curtain Fall Hour until the second quint, not a soul remained in Market by now.

He finally stood up and went home, all the way back was eerie silent, nothing left but his lingering thoughts.

Now at the entrance of his house he realized how worn out he was.

Yet Phainon hadn’t done anything straining the whole day to warrant such fatigue. He even completely forgot about his injury; mind occupied with worry.

Phainon sighed and took out his keys, unlocking the lock and opening his door to an empty house.

He needs to eat something, take a shower, change his bandages…just thinking about it was exhausting, but he did just that.

His mind wondered about both Mydei and Meowdei while he ate, and while he took a shower and even when he changed his bandages.

Why did every Mydei in existence just disappear after being in his presence? Is this a curse? Is this actually his flaw and Aglaea was wrong all along by telling him he was a flawless Chrysos Heir?

Now that he was out of the bathroom, fully cleaned and with new bandages, he put on his night clothes, while discarding the ones he worse today he took out his teleslate out of his pocket and realized he had unseen massages from both Tribbie and Aglaea.

Now fully changed he sat down on the edge of the bed, he took this time to also place the ring atop of the nightstand, he’ll put it in a better place later.

He opened Aglaea’s chat first, the messages were sent out recently.

Well easier said than done, he’s been crashing out solely out of sheer fatigue lately, he doubts he could catch a wink of sleep otherwise.

This night without Meowdei to keep his dreadful thoughts away is about to be one of the worst nights. With both Mydei and him missing his stress is increased, he isn’t sure he would be able to sleep, no matter how tired he is.

He lets out a heavy sigh.

Phainon texts Aglaea, thanking her for her hard work, and wishing her good night as well.

Then he opened Tribbie’s chat and was he reads keeps him still as if lightning just struck him.

These messages were sent hours ago.

Gods Phainon feels stupid for not checking his teleslate earlier.

But this means Meowdei is here, he’s somewhere in his house! But where he has been to his whole home already please don’t tell him he jumped off the balcony while he wasn’t home.

He was about to jump out of bed in a search frenzy when he heard the softest of snores coming from behind him.

Phainon turned around to find the Chimera sleeping facing his back at him, again, he needed to change these blasted orange blankets, he should burn them down in fact.

He can’t believe Meowdei was here the whole time.

Still, he didn’t feel anger towards the soft cloth for he was filled to the brim with a happiness he hadn’t felt since the day Mydei left.

“Meowdei!” He practically jumps from joy, turning around and climbing the bed so he could grab the sleepy Chimera.

Meowdei was confused and clearly not happy that he was suddenly awoken.

“Oh, I thought I lost you. I’m so sorry if I offended you earlier” Phainon held the Chimera close to him and gave it little kisses on his cheek not minding the fur that was getting on his lips.

The Chimera froze in confusion, not quite understanding what was happening after being rudely awakened by Phainon.

“Please don’t leave me again, I don’t think I can bear another loss” he said above a whisper as he cuddles the Chimera close to his face, tears starting to form in the corner of his eyes.

Meowdei relaxed in his hold, letting himself be coddled.

Phainon eventually laid down on bed holding Meowdei very close to his chest, a white flower, the one that Tribbie and her sisters like to wear was still perched at Meowdei’s head “I spent the whole day looking for you after you left, seems like you were having fun in my absence, huh” he finally smiled, looking at the Chimera’s eyes being reminded of Mydei once again.

“I really miss him Meowdei” Phainon gave him a tiny kiss atop of his forehead “You remind me so much of him…I can’t help but miss him, our competitions, his company, his voice…” He couldn’t help but pour his heart out again.

“At least I have you now, keeping someone as sorry as me company…”

Phainon let his eyes shut, now that he knew Meowdei was safe he was starting to get overwhelmed by exhaustion.

“I love you…please don’t leave me again” He felt his consciousness dissipating as he was welcomed to the realm of sleep.

Mydei was in a complete state of disbelief, apparently, he had worried Phainon to death all day.

Granted, he was the one who ran away and subsequently got “kidnaped” by Tribios.

He should apologize…somehow.

After being suddenly woken up last thing he thought it would happen was to see a teary-eyed Phainon telling him how much he cares about him.

At first Mydei felt guilty, but then Phainon started to kiss and cuddle him all over and all he could feel was heath all over his face.

He could simply not understand what was happening, Phainon pet and cuddle him yes…but he hadn’t gone so far as to kiss him.

And gods Mydei felt his face turn to fire every time Phainon laid a kiss on his fur.

He needed to keep reminding himself that this wasn’t Phainon kissing Mydei, this is Phainon kissing a Chimera, so there was no need to keep his hopes up.

But then Phainon started talking about how much he misses Mydei, how much he wishes he was here again, how much he reminds him of Mydei and how that comforts him.

And Phainon sounds heartbroken and Mydei doesn’t recall a single time his friend sounded as depressed as he does now.

Mydei was aware that Phainon valued him as much as Mydei valued Phainon but this? Phainon was letting his heart out to him, laid bare for him to see, and every single word spoke of care and love.

He was left wondering, if maybe he still had a chance, hope. Maybe he had it all wrong, but he wouldn’t know.

In the end he let his dreams engulf him, joining Phainon in his slumber.

Chapter End Notes
