chapters.html:
Chapter Notes

Oh, wow I said I would update before 3.4 (life is kicking my ass, sorry about that) but I think everyone would agree that we all need cute Chimera Meowdei after 3.4 am I right?....

Well 3.4 treated me good in the gacha at least, E0S1 Phainon and got E1 Tribbie to boot, very nice! Hope you all who wished for Phainon got him as well!

Anyways have fun reading.

Mydei woke up first, Kephale’s Dawn Device was shining intensely inside the room. Phainon hadn’t bothered to put down the blinders yesterday for whatever reason and now the strong rays of the early Entry Hour were assaulting Mydei’s eyes, forcing him to wake up.

Right now, the culprit of his early rise was quite literally bellow him, still fast asleep, he had Mydei wrapped into a comfortable embrace.

Mydei didn’t bother to move from atop Phainon’s chest, finding the place rather warm and comfortable.

He most definitely would’ve fallen asleep again if it wasn’t for the faint glimmer that was coming from the nightstand.

Curiosity picked, Mydei raised his head to get a better look only to find himself deadly still once he recognized the shape of the object atop of the nightstand.

It was a ring, plain and simple.

Whatever ounce of sleepiness that still inhabited his body suddenly vanished.

Phainon had already gone and got the ring then.

Ha, he felt like an idiot for even thinking he still had a chance, not when the evidence was right in front of him.

Mydei knew whatever Phainon wanted to do in his life wasn’t his business, yet he couldn’t fight the desire to know more, the desire to know who Phainon had decided to spend his whole life with.

With some effort Mydei was able to get himself free from Phainon’s grasp, he was careful with his movements, making sure to not waking the other man up.

If it was indeed a wedding ring, it was likely that the ring had the name of his beloved  engraved, then Mydei will know.

He couldn’t help but think that whoever was the person who held Phainon’s affection was incredibly lucky, he also felt a tinge of jealousy, something darker deeply rooted inside of him.

Each tiny step he took only made his heartbeat go faster, louder, the sound ringing in his ears, so loud that for a moment he thought he would wake Phainon up.

Mydei finally climbed the nightstand and took a dreadful look at the ring.

Now in full view from all sides he noticed he knew what that ring was rather…familiar? No, he knew this ring perfectly well, from memory even.

This wasn’t a wedding ring at all, it was a signet ring.

More specifically his mother’s.

Chimera’s eyes are naturally huge, he cannot even fathom how silly he must look right now, eyes wide as sources.

All these days, the assumptions he made, the coming wedding, the lover Phainon had…none of that existed?

Scratching all that for a second, how in all of Amphoreus Phainon got this ring.

Mydei was rightfully awestruck, mind running a mile per hour, as much as he tried to figure it out the ring could be for no other person than him.

This was undeniably for Mydei.

The ring…his mother’s signet ring…something he thought he would never see again in his life.

Phainon got this for him.

Mydei closed his eyes, suddenly it was too much, tears threatening to spill from his eyes at the memory of his mother.

Someone he had never met yet held very dear to his heart.

Memories of something he never lived coursing through his mind, the very same dream he had of his mother coming and going like the tides of the sea.

Yet he remembered his promise, he would shed a tear again.

“Oh no, please don’t touch that”

Phainon’s voice returned him to reality. Opening his eyes he found his friend fully awake, ring already in his hand.

Phainon was treating it like one of the finest treasures in existence, as if it could break just by not looking at it properly.

“Sorry, this is for Mydei…it’s his mother’s. Took us ages to find it, I’m just being cautious” Phainon looked down at the signet ring so fondly Mydei couldn’t process what he was seeing, absolutely transfixed just looking at the way Phainon smiled.

His friend let out a playful huff  “This really caught your attention huh?”

Phainon’s smile was warm and sincere, the ones Mydei love seeing the most.

At that moment he couldn’t help but think how in love he truly was.

“After Mydei told me about this ring, I just couldn’t sit idle” He carefully moved the ring in his hand, appreciating its beauty. The rays coming from the outside made the gold shine ever so brightly.

The signet ring was perfectly restored, brought back to its former glory.

Mydei still can’t believe Phainon had gone through all that trouble for him, this was something he deliberately did for Mydei.

“Once I heard it had been lost to the sea of souls, I knew I would need help, so I asked Chartonus for assistance. It took us days, but we managed to find it”

“The ring was, however, in less-than-optimal condition” Phainon frowned at the unpleasant memory  “So, I also asked him if he could restore it and he did a magnificent job, is as if its brand new. I really owe Chartonus a lot”

Mydei heard every single word, completely entranced by the story, Phainon went as far as to venture to the sea of souls just for Mydei, just for him.

“So, please don’t play with it, alright?” Normally Mydei would be offended for even thinking that he would do that, but he couldn’t when Phainon was like this, so fond of this, while he was being so careful  to preserve such a valuable item.

Phainon beamed as he scratched Mydei’s chin.

At this point, being petted was embedded into his being, it was so easy to accept, and so simple to not question, more so since it came from the person he cherished the most.

The moment didn’t last much, however. A second later, Phainon was already up making sure to wrap the signet ring in a fine handkerchief and later storing it in a hidden drawer near his bed.

Suddenly the sound of the teleslate ringed a few times, signaling the arrival of new messages. Phainon took a moment to get his teleslate and read the messages, only to end up sighing and turning it off.

“…I’m not sure what to do for the day” Phainon confessed, pondering what to do. If Mydei had to guess, Aglaea just sent him a message telling him to take the day off or something of the sort “Maybe we could just go for a walk…?”

There really wasn’t much to do except wait, he had already decided to leave things to Cipher (for better or worse), so having a moment for themselves wasn’t a bad idea.

Mydei jumped off the bed, scurrying to the front door so Phainon could understand that he agreed to the idea.

He just felt so many things right now, so many emotions were overwhelming him. He needed to do something, he needed to get out, he needed to tell Phainon that he loved him-

“Hey! we haven’t even eaten breakfast yet- Wait- we can go get breakfast at Kyros’! Great idea Meowdei!” …Not really what Mydei had in mind, but he certainly would not complain, right now he wanted Phainon, he wanted to spend his time with him.

Phainon quickly put on his boots and walked over to the door before stopping and going back to his bedroom.

“Forgot to change the clothes, haha” From the distance he could see as Phainon put his hand behind his head, looking a tad bit embarrassed.

…Some things would never change he guesses.

They made their way to Kyros’ restaurant where Phainon ordered for them both, completely ignoring the odd looks they were given by everyone around them since apparently, taking a Chimera to eat at a restaurant was something not so common.

He orders Honeycakes for the two of them, after making the order he looked back at Meowdei who was giving him a deadly glare (Why does he look so mad? He loves Honeycakes and these ones are warm and fresh!)

The order arrives without a hitch and Meowdei eats his whole meal without an issue (Phainon did order less for him and also asked for it to be cut beforehand for a more easy meal)

After their breakfast and paying Kyros handsomely for a meal well done, since they were already on the market, Phainon took the opportunity to buy some groceries.

 Aglaea specifically told him this was a day off, she was not taking a no for an answer and that he would also have to kill time today since Cipher was set to arrive today anyways.

Allegedly.

They really couldn’t be sure given her illusory nature, nor was it guaranteed that she would actually be able to find Mydei, but Phainon was willing to believe.

Walking around the marketplace was sure to brighten Phainon’s spirit, everyone was so cheerful and carefree and Phainon was more than happy to reciprocate their smiles and thanks with a cheerful grin and a wave he was so used to doing in public.

He was also secretly thankful nobody seemed to bring the topic of the missing Chrysos Heir to the table.

Phainon stopped by various stalls, Theodoros ancient artifact shop where Phainon helped him to check one relic out, the Librarium where Phainon bought a few new scrolls (making sure Meowdei didn’t get ahold to any of them) and they even passed by Chartonus to say hi.

They eventually ended up at Demetria’s store, where Phainon stopped and bought a few pomegranates, when Meowdei looked up at him with so much shine in his eyes he couldn’t help but to lower one pomegranate for Meowdei.

“I was planning to save them up for Mydei when he came back but you can have one”

At first it almost looked like the Chimera was offended, as if he had to offer him the pomegranate in a silver platter, but he eventually gave it a bite.

And another, and another…until eventually his entire face was buried inside the pomegranate.

“Oh dear” Phainon let out a hearty laugh “You also like them? I can’t believe it, maybe I should by more”

He doubted the animal was hearing him at this point, so entranced by the fruit.

When he finished and finally lifted his head Phainon couldn’t help but burst out laughing.

The Chimera looked at him bewildered, unable to understand the cause of such a reaction.

In reality Meowdei mouth and cheeks were completely red after eating the pomegranate, making him look rather silly,

“Oh dear, when was the last time I laughed that much…” When Mydei was here, is what his traitorous mind told him.

Ignoring the dreadful thought trying to creep in, he searched in his pocket for a handkerchief and did his best to clean Meowdei up.

He kneeled before the Chimera, Phainon made sure to grab it carefully around the face as he tried to clean the rest of pomegranate juice that was left in the little animal’s fur.

“You really made a mess, huh” Meowdei for what is worth, was very expressive for being a Chimera, Phainon could swear that he was rather embarrassed right now.

Phainon did his best to take it all out, but it wasn’t quite easy since he was only using a handkerchief and most of it got stuck directly in his fur.

In the end he had to give up, Meowdei’s face ended up just being a fading pink color by the end.

Phainon let out a sigh “It’s not coming off…but no problem! Let’s just go to the baths and use one of the community showers to take it off completely”

When they finally got into the showers Phainon took only his coat out and folded it neatly and left it on a dry area.

He also grabbed a tiny towel that would be enough to dry the Chimera once they were done.

He positioned Meowdei in the center of the shower, and he looked…not so pleased about what was about to happen.

Phainon took the hand shower, putting his hand in front of it to manage the temperature of the water.

Once he deemed that the temperature was good enough to shower the Chimera, he went ahead and started soaking the animal thoroughly in his face area.

He was answered with a hiss and multiple grumbles in protest but otherwise Meowdei made no movement and stayed in place as Phainon cleaned his cheeks free of pomegranate juice.

“So grumpy! I’m simply cleaning the mess that you made” Phainon swears he just saw Meowdei roll his eyes at him.

He’s telling the truth! Meowdei could be a little bit more considerate, he was taking the time to clean him after all...

Once Meowdei was nice and cleaned Phainon grabbed the towel and put it on his lap, then grabbed Meowdei a put him right where the towel was.

He would get a bit wet, but the floor was entirely soaked, and he won’t be able to dry Meowdei properly otherwise.

He started drying Meowdei starting with his head, then the cheeks and oh it was just utterly adorable, he really can’t believe such a creature exists.

Phainon’s heart melted as he saw the Chimera’s cheeks move as he was drying then all while Meowdei made the cutest frowning face with half closed eyes.

He then moved to dry the Chimera in the rest of his body, the chest, the back, the body, the legs, even the tail that dried rather fast since it was scaly rather than furry

The critter remained still as ever during the entirety of the session not even moving when Phainon dried his paws.

Now that Meowdei was thoroughly cleaned, dry and extra fluffy it was time to pick their next destination.

Or so Phainon thought until Meowdei jumped off his lap and ran to the direction where the hot baths were located.

“Meowdei wait! Where are you going?!” Phainon jumped from his seat, ditching his attire on the spot in order to pursue Meowdei.

Only to regret it and come back for them a moment later, he doesn’t want to get in trouble with Aglaea again.

This step back was enough for Meowdei to get the advantage, once Phainon was all caught up, Meowdei was already relaxing in the hot baths near the other few guests that liked their water hotter than usual.

Phainon could only stare at the creature in disbelief, he just dried him up damn it.

“…I literally just dried you Meowdei. Are you really doing this to me? To your friend?” The Chimera merely opened one of his little closed eyes to inspect him.

He most likely looked like a mess, with only his shirt and pants on, cloak in hand, thoroughly soaked in the middle since that’s where he was holding Meowdei, along with his misbehaved hair from all the steam and running here and there.

The Chimera merely hummed as he closed his eye once more, moving to the side to “make space” urging Phainon to come in.

Phainon sighed and took the hint, this was a relaxing day devoid of worries, might as well indulge his little friend while he can.

The man took the time to take the rest of his clothes off, walked inside the bath and sat next to the Chimera, making sure to not wet his bandages that much as well.

Mydei was fond of the hot baths more than Phainon. The Kremnoans would often bathe in stirring hot water as if was nothing, while Phainon suffered from sensitive skin and he could not really last very long inside of them.

Only when he got into fierce competitions with Mydei, Phainon would do his best to endure the heat (he has never been able to beat the prince in this regard however)

He was willing to indulge Meowdei now, just like he would often indulge Mydei…

Those two shared so many similarities it was staggering, even Phainon was impressed to discover such a Chimera existed.

….

It couldn’t be right?

Phainon took a moment to look at Meowdei, his eyes were closed fully immersed in the heat of the bath.

Nah, it couldn’t be. Phainon would notice.

The mere idea of Mydei turning into a Chimera was just ridiculous, ha! As if something like that would happen to Mydeimos of all people.

Meowdei eventually drifted by his side, ever so close. Phainon took a moment to scratch his back.

They stayed like that for a while before the effect of the heat was noticeable for Phainon.

Too…hot.

Phainon stood up from the baths, the sudden ripple in the water alerted Meowdei that seemingly fell asleep in the water.

Sorry little guy but Phainon is getting cooked alive here.

Once he got out, however he realized he didn’t bring a towel with him.

The only towel he had was the tiny towel he used to dry Meowdei which was completely soaked and barely covered one side of him…

He really didn’t think this through…

Being naked in the baths was far from embarrassing, but there was something about parading all around the place with a measly half wet towel and having to go ask for a bigger one that Phainon wasn’t all that happy about.

After a slightly embarrassing moment in the baths, he finally got himself clothed and Meowdei dry (yes, Meowdei was a good Chimera and did not jump back in the water after he dried him again)

As for his next destination…He was drawing blanks, maybe they could go to the Garden of Life and spend some time with the other Chimeras? Still, this was not his decision alone to make, he should ask Meowdei what he thinks.

“What do you want to do now Meowdei? Wanna go to the Garden of Life to check on your friends?”

He looked down at Meowdei to see his reaction, when he was met with a fierce shake to the sides, a rotund NO, he couldn’t help but laugh out loud.

“You really dread to work huh?”

An icy glare was all he got from the Chimera.

“Fine, fine, I get it. Where do you want to go then?”

Meowdei looked at him for a second before marching outside of the baths.

Phainon followed the little critter all the way out of the baths, until they were at the main road leading to the Marmoreal Palace.

Here the scenery was beautiful, it had plenty of green and places to sit down,  you could spend hours looking at the people slowly coming and going as the day progressed.

They decided to sit down on a bench that was near a Dromas post Mydei also jumped in and sat down right beside him.

It was a quiet day, he hoped that wherever Mydei might be he was having as much peace as they were right now.

Now that he realized they haven’t eaten anything yet since their breakfast and time for lunch was long gone, they really should eat something.

Thankfully he was still carrying the things they bought today at the market.

Phainon put out the pre-made food package he bought alongside the groceries, he really wasn’t thinking of getting back home until late anyways, so…

Phainon looked to his right, Meowdei was slowly closing his eyes, but trying to keep them open, he was clearly struggling to stay awake.

How many hours a day does a Chimera sleep? He really ought to look it up…

It wasn’t time for sleeping, however.

“Here, I know you are falling asleep but try to not sleep with an empty stomach”

He distributed his food with Meowdei, which quietly ate his fill alongside Phainon.

Once they were done Phainon realized he was also rather sleepy.

Phainon stored the box back on his bag and stood up to look for a better place to nap, it would do him no good to just sleep on a bench.

There was a patch of grass rather big nearby where a Dromas was taking a nap in front of a pile of redsoil.

The grass looked green and welcoming, nothing like the wheat fields back at home, but it had the same sentiment.

Ahh, perfect napping spot.

He got comfortable on the ground, and looked to his right, Meowdei was already curling himself next to him, ready to sleep again.

What a perfect place to fall asleep to…

…

Phainon woke up an hour later to something wet being smeared on his face.

Wet and slimy and- oh Titans the Dromas was licking his face “Ugh! What are you doing?” He said as he quickly stood up and backed away from the gentle giant.

He moved around as he tried to remove the saliva completely forgetting the sleeping Chimera next to him, and he ended up accidentally stepping into his tail while trying to get away from the Dromas.

The howl of absolute pain that followed would torment Phainon for the rest of his life.

Meowdei cried in pain as he was rudely awakened from his quiet nap.

And Phainon?

Oh, Phainon felt like the worst scum that had ever had the disgrace to walk on Amphoreus.

He had never moved so fast in his life, quickly removing his feet as soon as he heard the noise coming from his friend.

“Meowdei!” He screamed as he got down to the Chimera’s level.

The sound of agony had stopped; only little whimpers would come out of the tiny creature now.

Phainon held him up and cradled him into his arms near his chest, trying to see if he actually had done everlasting damage or something like that.

Thankfully it seemed like the tail was good, just a little bruised…

Phainon let out a sigh of relief, yet his guilt remained, he would never hurt Meowdei, never.

Yet he was standing here in front of his friend, clearly hurt due to his careless actions.

He hugged the Chimera close, their foreheads almost touching.

“I’m sorry Meowdei I…I hurt you” He stayed quiet for a second, trying to gather the courage to see the Chimera face to face.

Phainon finally looked down at Meowdei and saw…a deadpan expression?

Meowdei took this chance to put on his paw on Phainon’s face, face completely unimpressed.

For some reason, he heard Mydei’s voice inside of his head “Did you really think I would be bothered by something so insignificant?”

Ah.

Phainon was exaggerating.

He quickly gave a smooch to Meowdei’s forehead and put the animal back on the ground.

“Oh well, where are we going now friend?” He said, trying to change the topic.

He felt rather embarrassed right now….

They ended up wandering around Okhema without a clear destination, walking around, just taking the view, talking with the citizens…

It wasn’t until their feet brought them to the Dromas workshop that Phainon thought that maybe he could present some of them better to Meowdei, but at the same time he was reminded of his earlier mishap which made him hesitate.

Meowdei was rather small, and the Dromas were tall and big. If they were the ones stepping on Mydei then-

Phainon doesn’t want to think about such a scenario.

He was about to leave when he saw Mydei adventuring inside the workshop without telling him.

Phainon’s heart stopped beating for a moment, eyes widening at the scene unfolding in front of him.

He quickly went after the Chimera and grabbed him with both hands “Just where are you going?! You are so small you can’t walk around here as you please-” Phainon frowned not approving of such reckless action “Here, let me- I’ll just grab you and show you around”

He ended up pulling Meowdei way up in the air, so he could see the Dromas much better.

Dromas looked down at him with curiosity, most of them probably never saw a Chimera before, given the different duties they fulfilled, alongside the fact of their size difference made things rather complicated for the two.

What he didn’t really expect was that one of the Dromas was getting especially excited at the sight of Meowdei.

“Hey! Stop it for a second” Phainon was getting overwhelmed as well as Meowdei, the Dromas snout encapsulating them both as he tried to cuddle next to them, or more accurately next to Meowdei.

Phainon couldn’t handle it anymore, so he took a few steps back suddenly realizing which Dromas was in front of him “Wait, its Kokopo” Phainon said a bit bitterly “Bad Kokopo! You are going to crush us to death if you keep doing that”  Mydei would say he’s a madman if he was here, because Kokopo was the sweetest Dromas ever, suuure. Phainon knew better and right now he could swear Kokopo was frowning at him.

That Dromas doesn’t like Phainon at all.

“I’m sure you miss Mydei as much as I do but you can’t just put your snout on the nearest similar thing you find without permission” He protectively hugged the Chimera on his hold, shielding him from the gigantic animal.

Dormas were peaceful and careful creatures, that’s why that he didn’t entirely give on the idea of showing them to the Chimera.

But maybe Kokopo was an exception

The Dromas stomped its foot in jealousy (?), demanding more cuddles with the Chimera.

Phainon refused, he knew that Dromas couldn’t hurt a fly, but he still had a fear that Meowdei might get stomped by accident and he rather be dead before letting Meowdei get hurt again.

That is until Meowdei jumped out of his hold and directed themselves to the redsoil compartment at the speed of light.

Phainon practically let out a squeal of anxiety and ran after him, but the Chimera was already atop of the redsoil.

“He’s going to get eaten, oh Titans, my baby Chimera is going to get confused by redsoil and he’s going to get eaten” Phainon thought, clearly not panicking at all.

But before he could grab Meowdei and run away with him, Kokopo downed his head and gave Meowdei the most soft and gentle head rub he’s ever witnessed, so much that it left him surprised.

Phainon halted.

This was akin to seeing a Pegasus amidst a forest, a rare animal occurrence.

It melted his heart.

That was before Kokopo devoured Meowdei.

Phainon was left on an absolute state of shock before screaming “KOKOPOOO!”

Ok- maybe Phainon was exaggerating. Kokopo didn’t devour Meowdei, he merely grabbed him by the neck like a momma lion would to her cub.

Still, Phainon rushed at the creature, demanding, no, begging for him to let Meowdei down “Kokopo, no- The Fierce Beats of Kremnos: Kokopo the III, please put Meowdei down please, you are going to hurt him, please I’m begging you!”

But as always, his plights fell to deaf ears as Kokopo moved Meowdei around with his mouth, very slowly until finally letting him go exactly in his back, where the seats to drive the Dromas are usually located.

Phainon just watched in shock at what was transpiring in front of him, Kokopo wanted Meowdei…to ride him?

What nonsense of all nonsense was this.

He was left there gawking at the scene. It looked absolutely ridiculous, just Meowdei looking all mighty in the Dromas sit despite his tiny size, it indubitably exuding the aura of an absolute ruler, a King.

He really was like Mydei.

It took the help of a few caretakers to let Meowdei down and finally get away from Kokopo who only calmed down after he got a few more cuddles with Meowdei.

What was Kokopo’s deal anyway…he simply had an incredible obsession with Mydei.

At least that tells that Mydei takes care of his animals all right…

After that tiny (big) scare, Phainon decided it was better to sit down and relax for a second he might lose more years out of his lifetime if things keep going like this.

He ended up sitting by one of the communal benches that were nearby, Meowdei quickly jumped into the bench and sat next to him.

Then Phainon had an idea, he grabbed Meowdei and put him on his lap.

To his surprise Meowdei didn’t protest and easily gave in to Phainon’s pets and started to purr.

Oh, he needed this.

They stayed like that, quiet, at this hour many were busy working so the place around them was quite tranquil.

Until that tranquility was broken by loud buzzling sounds coming from his teleslate, a string of messages from Aglaea.

Phainon swallowed, where they good or bad news?...

He unlocked the phone and looked at the messages.

As she’s typing? Wouldn’t that mean that Cipher-

“Hey there Deliver boy!”

-would be here any second now.

That was certainly fast, the power of the Demigod of Trickery was an outstanding one, he was still amazed at it, no matter how many times he saw it.

“Cipher! I’m glad to see you again, it’s been a while”

About two years to be precise, she really doesn’t come around that often. More of a reason to be grateful to her for helping them out in such a dire moment.

He could feel Meowdei shift on his lap, seemingly waking up from his quick nap.

“I heard it all from Aglaea. Little lion prince has gone missing right? Well, we’ll have to start working hard to get your boy toy back”

Phainon couldn’t help but frown at the crude comment “He’s not my-“

“Anyways, as things are right now, I really can’t do anything” She shook her head “You’ll have to be more…generous with me”

Seriously? Did her greed know no bounds? She should know that Phainon doesn’t have that much money. He’s always using it to buy relics or new swords.

He just used all the money he had on him to buy groceries too, Gods damn it!

Before he could negotiate with her however, she continued “And of course, I’ll need a bit more info on the case. You can’t simply say the little lion disappear one day and expect me to-“

She didn’t manage to finish before Meowdei jumped at her with a speed that surprised Phainon, but it was certainly no match for Cipher’s speed.

So Meowdei promptly failed and fell down headfirst to the ground.

Phainon didn’t spare a second before taking him back on his arms, trying to rub circles where Meowdei just got hurt “Meowdei! What do you think you are doing?”

“Meowdei? Did you really name it-“ Cipher stopped, eyes shifting to see the Chimera more properly.

Only to burst out laughing, it was a hearty one, like she hadn’t laughed in years- she laughed as if seeing a Chimera fall to the ground was the most hilarious thing in all of Amphoreus.

“His fall can’t be this funny” Phainon was frowning, at the same time he was trying hard to not let Meowdei go since he seemed to have some murderous intent on Cipher.

“Ahh, I haven’t laugh so much in a while” she whipped away a tear “I’m going to tell you a thing. I will look for the little prince, right now…”

She tossed the coin up in the air and then she disappeared as if she wasn’t here a moment ago.

…Did she got an idea just now of where Mydei could be? She just set off!

Phainon was left there bewildered for a few minutes…was this a good thing? Phainon can’t quite comprehend why she suddenly knew something but-

Before he could finish pondering, she was back in an instant.

“Cipher? What happened?” Phainon said, now eager to know if Cipher found something.

“Oh, you see…” She boped Meowdei little nose, taking it away a millisecond before he could bite it “You don’t need to worry about a thing. Me disappearing just now? I just had an idea. I was just checking around the area, and lo and behold who do I find near the border of Okhema. Deliver boy take a guess who that was”

Phainon’s eyes widened, she actually found Mydei?! Did she really find him? “You found him? Is he alright? Why didn’t he come back with you?”

Cipher may lie all the time, but there was no way she would lie about something so serious, much less if Aglaea was involved.

Still, he needed to be sure, he wanted to hear it

Cipher smiled wicked “I’ll tell you if you pay me enough. Oh, just kidding, I’m kidding! don’t make that face, I know you are broke.”  

Phainon gave her a deadpan stare, she was right but that didn’t mean she should outright say it out loud.

On the other hand, Meowdei was relentless, he just wouldn’t keep still. What was his problem with Cipher? Is it because she’s like a cat? Do Chimeras not get along with them?

“Your man is fine, alright. He’s on his way here in fact. I’m sure he’ll be here with you very soon. Who knows, maybe he’ll greet you right when morning comes”

Letting out the part where she claimed Mydei was his man (Gods he wished), the fact that Mydei was nice and safe and would be here around tomorrow’s morning was the best news he heard in years.

Phainon let out a sigh of relief, he felt as if a weight was taken off his shoulders.

All that he wishes to know now is why, why did Mydei leave without telling them? What has he been up to?

Whatever the case, Phainon was sure its justified, even if he almost died of worry multiple times, at least he had Meowdei by his side to make things more bearable.

“Thank you Cipher- I really don’t think I can’t thank you enough for this”

“Oh, you always can! I accept cash any day of the year” she said with a wide grin.

She was the greediest person in Amphoreus alright.

If she’s completely right, however, he would make sure to repay her properly later.

“…I’ll keep that in mind”

“No worries, it’s a pleasure doing business with you “ and just like that she took her coin out, flip it on the air and disappeared, leaving Phainon alone with Meowdei.

He sat back down the bench again and let out the biggest sigh of relief in his entire life.

Mydei was fine, he’s safe.

And he will be here soon.

Hopefully tomorrow morning.

He starts petting Meowdei again, who was right by his side now, looking at the direction where Cipher had run off.

He seemed to calm down now that the demigod was gone, letting himself be caressed on his back making him fall asleep again.

Phainon stayed there for a moment, breathing the air, taking in the scenery…life had seemed to regain its warmth again.

It was hard having to wake up Meowdei from his comfortable lap nap, but it was already the third quint of the Parting Hour, and they still had to eat dinner before going to bed.

In the time he let Meowdei nap he looked up how many hours a day a Chimera slept, it was eighteen hours, no wonder he was always sleepy. And these are the critters the scholars use to work with? Phainon needs to look this up more deeply when he has the time.

In the end Meowdei groggily woke up but understood that it was time to go.

That conversation with Cipher had left Phainon calm and excited for the next day, to be able to see Mydei again…Phainon doesn’t know what he would tell him once they reunite.

Gods, he’s making it sound as if they hadn’t seen each other in years and it’s been barely a few days.

It sure felt like an eternity though.

Once home, Phainon arranged the table to eat with Meowdei, he still had some Mydei reserve food left for dinner, although he was starting to run low on them…

At this point he still wasn’t sure what Meowdei should eat but he’s been eating Mydei’s healthy food without issues, so he guesses it was okay for the Chimera to eat human food.

After a nice dinner, Phainon stood in front of his wardrobe, wondering for a second if he should wear the Dromas onesie he got from professor Anaxa after graduating before opting to just wear his regular sleep wear, (which was awesome with a mix of dull red and neon purple) it looked fantastic!

He then got on his bed and tucked himself in, Meowdei joined shortly after beside him, but Phainon decided to grab him a put the Chimera at top of his chest so he could maximize cuddle time.

Now that Mydei was coming back tomorrow, he could finally make these two meet each other, how exciting.

Phainon is sure Mydei will like Meowdei very much, he most likely will complain about the name, but Phainon couldn’t help himself while naming him, they are just too alike.

He caressed the Chimera’s chin, effectively making it lift his head up and close his eyes, it soon started purring, he was thoroughly enjoying it.

Phainon couldn’t help but smile, he knew Chimeras were adorable creatures but living with Meowdei these past few days have changed his view entirely, they were not only adorable but extremely good companions as well.

Maybe he should’ve taken a pet sooner. It’s just that Chimeras are intelligent and can take care of themselves for the most part, which doesn’t really make them a pet, but they sure are a great company.

He couldn’t help feeling his eyes starting to close slowly, getting carried away with the soft purrs and low vibrations on his chest.

Despite his excitement for the next day Phainon eventually gave in and drifted off to sleep.

Phainon still had his eyes closed and was half awake when he realized something very, very heavy was pushing down on his chest.

It was getting a little hard to breathe and with half of his brain still frozen he couldn’t really formulate in his mind what exactly was happening.

So, he opened his eyes, only to find a very familiar shade of blond in front of him, a lightly tan muscular body filled with flaming red tattoos was greeting him.

Mydei.

Mydei was back, he was back, and he was right in front of him.

He wasn’t dreaming now, was he?

Phainon rubbed his eyes just in case he was seeing things but no, this was indeed Mydei in front of him, sleeping and hugging Phainon?

Whatever kind of sleepiness he had was absolutely gone now, Cipher was right, thank Kephale.

“Mydei!” Phainon couldn’t help exclaiming, his voice still raspy from just waking up.

“…what?” was the first thing Phainon heard, way hoarser than expected from someone who just woke up, it sounded more like he hadn’t’ spoke in a week.

Phainon couldn’t help but to hug Mydei back, a little bit awkward since they were both lying in bed, but still quite sweet “Mydei you are back! I missed you so much”

He could feel the body atop of him freeze for a second in realization before tightening the hugging.

They embraced each other in silence for a while, just happy to be together again. Phainon felt his tears trying to slip away from his eyes.

A moment passed, then another, now Phainon was observing a little bit better and-

“Mydei…my I ask you something? “ Phainon broke the scared silence that was held between them.

“…What is it?”
“…are you naked right now?”

To which Mydei responded with a pair of surprised eyes, suddenly the blankets that Phainon was tucked into were stripped away by Mydei in order to wrap himself with them.

His face was completely red, not looking at Phainon directly in the eyes “Don’t just stay there staring”

“I- sorry, it’s just-” Phainon really wanted to ask Mydei where in the world he was all this time, and why he left but new things kept popping up- like, why was he butt naked? In Phainon’s bed too?? Why was he hugging him before they woke up??? And now-

“Mydei are those Chimera ears you have on?” Was it a prop? He has seen a few merchandises of different animal ears for sale before.

Mydei’s eyes widened again, he used one hand to touch his head, then he touched one of the two ears, the moment he did that the other one seemed to twitch in response.

…That looked way to real to be a prop he put on his head.

The ears were the same color of blond as his hair; they looked round and fluffy just as Meowdei’s- where was the Chimera anyways? Did Mydei kicked him from the bed so he could…cuddle Phainon?

Suddenly the realization of everything that was happening hit him, Mydei was being way too close to him right now, sleeping together, the hugging, the…nakedness.

He could feel his cheeks starting to redden at the thought of Mydei wanting this…wanting Phainon.

He would not ask about it, wouldn’t dare to, this was probably a coincidence! Somehow.

Phainon should better ask about what the hell was happening with those ears instead!

Well, he was but then Mydei decided to look all around his body and well- that completely distracted Phainon. He followed Mydei’s line of sight until he stopped while he looked…behind him?

Phainon decided to sit and look as well and was surprised when he found a long bright scaly orange tail that faded into a green tip, very reminiscent of Meowdei coming from Mydei’s lower back.

He could hear Mydei whisper under his breath, sounding confused and bothered “What? Why is it still going...”

Just what the hell was going on? Mydei was back but he had Chimera attributes now? And where the hell Meowdei ran off to?

Phainon tried his best to look around the room without disturbing Mydei, which only allowed him to move his head to look around the room, but Meowdei was nowhere to be seen, he probably was in the living area then?

“…Are you looking for the Chimera?” Mydei said, breaking the silence they unknowably caused.

“How did you know?”

Mydei sighed “Phainon think about it for a second”

Wait…Mydei appeared exactly in the same spot as Meowdei when Phainon went to sleep, a now Mydei has Chimera ears and a tail exactly like Meowdei which could only mean…

Phainon let out a loud gasp, not believing what was happening “Did you fuse with Meowdei overnight!?”

Mydei slapped his face, not the right answer then.

Mydei sighed “…I am Meowdei Phainon, or more accurately I was Meowdei”

Phainon’s mind went blank for a second, trying to process the information.

It took a moment, but the gears finally started spinning inside his head.

If Mydei was indeed Meowdei then…

This whole time.

This whole damned time he was taking care of Meowdei it was instead Mydei himself?

Mydei was just with him, all this time.

When Phainon brought him to all places in Okhema when he was looking for Mydei, when he named him, when Meowdei froze when he littered him with cuddle and kissed, all that time he was actually…

Phainon’s face turned red in record time, shame washing him for not noticing before, along with the fact he did so many things with Meowdei-

He himself pointed out multiple times that Meowdei looked too much like Mydei, hell,  the whole reason why he even took Meowdei with him was because he looked like Mydei.

He feels so stupid for not giving the idea a proper chance to ponder it completely.

Then his mind vividly recalled how the other night he held Meowdei in his arms, whispering his oh so vulnerable thoughts, his love, his confession…

Georios please open the earth in half and swallow him whole, Mydei wasn’t supposed to hear any of that.

“I-I’m sorry Mydei, I-”

It’s all he managed to say, a hundred scenarios that they lived together were replaying on his head, trying to piece them together and give them the added context of  “Mydei was there”

Gods the ring, he told Mydei about the ring.

He felt deflated as he dropped his back against the bed.

“What are you apologizing for?”

“I should’ve realized sooner Mydei- Everything I said and done and-” Phainon tried to wriggle backwards, his head now touching the wall behind him. He stared at the ground next to him, he couldn’t bring himself to look at Mydei right now.

Mydei, however, grew ever closer to him. His warm hand reached for Phainon’s chin and guided Phainon to look at Mydei directly face to face.

“Tell me about the things you said” His equal mumbled, such a gentle tone had him entranced in just a second.

Phainon had nowhere to run to, he could only see Mydei, and he would admit that the man looked nothing but ethereal. The rays of light coming from the Dawn Device were enough to illuminate his face in a way that could only be described as divine.

Phainon couldn’t feel more enamored.

He recalled once again the words he whispered so dearly “I said I missed you, that I didn’t want you to leave me…” Mydei’s hand was now cupping his cheek, Phainon leaned into the warmth.

“Do you regret telling me?” Mydei asked ever so curious.

“No”  Phainon answered in a heartbeat, despite what his mind was saying- screaming even- he didn’t dare saying yes, as embarrassing as it was.

And then it hit him, he really told Mydei about the ring…

It was better to confront it now, that to pretend it didn’t happen “So, you know about the signet ring…”

“I do”

A pit of dread was forming in his stomach not knowing how Mydei would react to such gift he planned, still, he asked “…what do you think about it?”

“I think I love you”

…

What

Did he hear Mydei right?

He echo his own thought “What?”

Suddenly Mydei got incredible close, his hand still cupping Phainon’s cheek. He felt as if he couldn’t breathe.

“Phainon“ Mydei face had a brush of red “I will forever be grateful for what you have done, and this it’s not just about the ring” Mydei looked down for a second before continuing  “You took care of me even if you weren’t aware, you looked for me when I “disappeared”, you never gave up hope even when there were seemingly where no leads. You are attentive, caring, you are always there when I need you, you always have my back on the battlefield, …I think I could go on all day”

Phainon stayed there, speechless, Mydei was coming at him with everything and Phainon could only gawk and stare.

“A few days ago, when I overheard the conversation about the ring, my mind jumped at the conclusion that you had found someone especial already. At the time, I accepted it, I thought to myself that you deserved it, you deserved the love, even if I was not the one giving it to you” A pause, a deep breath.

“But now I want to be that one, if you would have me…I want to be the one that gives you that love Phainon”

Phainon felt that he couldn’t breathe, was he really awake? Everything that happened until now seemed like a dream, from Meowdei actually being Mydei, from Mydei still having Chimera traits after changing back and now Mydei confessing his love to him.

It was too much.

But Mydei was real, he watched him over like a God looking down at his perfect creation in a way that Phainon could only describe as tender, patently waiting for an answer.

Phainon completely blanked out however- understandable, given that the man before him, the man he’s been pinning for years now, the most beautiful man on amphoreus, the one only person Phainon has even hold romantic affection towards just confessed to him and wanted to love him.

Also, he was naked and very sexy but forgetting that-

Phainon, instead of formulating an actual response, was left opening and closing his mouth like a dumb fish.

Mydei sighed and took his hand away, but before he could Phainon grabbed his wrist, not letting him go just yet.

“Mydei…” He looked up at Mydei’s face, the prettiest amber eyes looking back at him, like a sunset, Phainon had memorized their shape and color to heart as there was nothing else in the world, he'd rather get lost in.

He put Mydei’s hand back to his cheek, leaning back to it, Mydei’s eyes soften at the motion.

“You laid bare your feelings before me so I it’s only fair I do the same, right?” Even if he technically did so already, he still hadn’t voiced everything.

He took a deep breath, the released “I think I feel in love the very first time I’ve meet you”

Mydei was surprised for a slip second before he chuckled a little as he smiled, finding the confession amusing.

“It’s true! Don’t laugh, I know it sound cheesy” Mydei looked down at him with an expression that could only be described as enamored.

He didn’t say anything but urged Phainon to continue.

Phainon redden a little, if it was even possible to do so more.

“I just never meet someone so, so…” Phainon struggled to find the right word, but there was no single word that could encapsulate Mydei.

“Beautiful, strong, dutiful, it seems like you are good at  anything you put your hands on” He grabs Mydei’s hand and press on a tiny kiss on his palm “You are always there for me, there’s no one else that can keep up with me, I just- I love you Mydei”

For a second he didn’t process what was happening, but Mydei had thrown himself atop of Phainon, cupping his face with both hands and started to kiss him.

Frankly Phainon didn’t know what to do, he was incredibly inexperienced in anything related to love, so he did his best to let Mydei take the lead, and he would follow.

He closed his eyes, letting the moment play for him in darkness.

Mydei kissed him slowly, carefully, as if giving it less thought would explode them both, Phainon couldn’t help but melt as Mydei continued to kiss him for what it seemed a lifetime.

When they parted Phainon’s face was almost the shade of a tomato, both men were almost panting, trying to regain their breath after the long action.

 “Oh wow” Is all Phainon’s mind could conjure at the moment, and all that was able to come out of his mouth.

“Is that all you are going to say?” Mydei said, smirking “I really do love you” Phainon uttered, and once again Mydei was all over him kissing him as if his life depended on it.

By all the Titans combined, he would give up everything to have Mydei at his side kissing him forever.

They went on and on like that for a while, beautiful whispers followed by lovely kisses. All the sweet nothings they whispered to each other, years of secret love finally coming out to devour them both.

Now that they have both calmed down, their heated moment now dwindled, Phainon could voice a concerned he had for a while now.

“Mydei?”

Mydei hummed, he could feel the vibration of his voice on his chest and oh did that do things to Phainon’s heart.

“Maybe you should um…get dressed?”

“Ah” Mydei frowned and looked down at himself, he was still using the blankets to cover himself.

“Don’t worry I’ll just spare you some of my clothes” Phainon said with all the glee in the world, they were barely boyfriends (they were after all this right?) and Mydei would already be wearing his clothes, he couldn’t be more delighted-

“No, thank you”

“What?”

Ah, the sound of a thousand dreams shattered.

Mydei crossed his arms and looked down at him in all seriousness “I saw what you have in there and I’m not using any of it”

Titans, why did his lover have to be oh so sweet yet so cruel.

“But-“ He pouted like a puppy.

“No”

It was final.

“Fine. Do you want me to go to your house and get your own clothes then?” He tried to mask his disappointment in his voice.

That idea seemed to make Mydei rather happy. He looked at Phainon with a tenderness in his eyes that could melt any ice “That would be very sweet of you”

Oh.

That smile, that tone of voice, who cares if Mydei doesn’t wear his clothes, Phainon would rip the world apart to make his lover happy.

“I will go get them-“

He tried to stand but Mydei pushed him back in bed.

“Spare me a few more minutes before you go?”

“Ye-“ is all he managed to say before being assaulted by another kiss.

And after that one went another…and another…until the matter of getting the clothes back was nothing but a thought pushed away in the corner of his mind.

Phainon couldn’t hope or even dream of such a moment, of being with someone like Mydei, of sharing a moment like this.

He hopes this bond will last eternally, that their blood will run deep and forever entangled, may they never find misfortune and for their love to be everlasting.

This, this is Phainon’s dream.

Chapter End Notes

Well, this would be the end of the fanfic, I know, I know it says 4/5 chapters, I will write and Epilogue with short stories where Mydei sees the other Chrysos Heirs and the Kremnoans as he tries to fix himself fully as well (oh and Phainon is there too ig) It’s not entirely over but, you know.

“I’ll send a message in the Chrysos Heirs group chat to let them know you are back, ok?” Phainon said as he pulled out his teleslate from his pocket.

After spending a well over two hours in bed doing nothing but cuddling and kissing he managed to convince Phainon about going to his house to get his clothes and teleslate back (granted it was half his fault for keeping him in bed the first time, but after that Phainon was just dragging the moment and as much as Mydei enjoyed it he needed those clothes back) now that things calmed down, they were both eating together.

Mydei paused eating breakfast for a moment to answer “Sure” after hearing his approval Phainon went to type the news for everyone.

Mydei went back to his meal only to frown once again today.

It was Honekycakes.

Again.

Mydei doesn’t remember making these many for Phainon, what the hell was wrong with his boyfriend.

He’s mentally listing at least 30 different breakfast options for Phainon after this.

He heard the buzzing notification of Phainon’s message coming from his own teleslate beside him, not even a minute later the teleslate wouldn’t stop buzzing so Mydei picked it up and opened the group chat

With a new promise to meet up, Mydei finished off his food and was now washing his plate alongside Phainon’s on the kitchen sink.

Once finished Mydei took a look at Phainon and immediately realized he was making one of those  “I want to ask you something, but I don’t know if I should”  face.

Mydei sighed “What do you want to ask?” Phainon’s eyes widen then softened once again “I was just thinking…” He paused, trying to find the right words to ask.

 “Why did you lash on Cipher yesterday when she came by? And now you want to look for her?”

Ah, so that was it. He doesn’t understand why his aggressive reaction towards her from yesterday. He doesn’t personally have any qualms with Cipher, she, however, was pushing the line of what Mydei thought was reasonable.

“I didn’t like the way she was talking to you- about us” He ended up saying, which was true. That’s how his annoyance started.

“What? It wasn’t that bad”   Phainon said, incredulously, as if playing around his lack of money and talking about as if she knew their relationship didn’t warrant some attention.

Not to mention…

“She also made fun of me”

“Well-“

“And lied to your face”

“I mean-“

“Multiple times I might add”

“That’s just-“

“She even kept asking for more money even though she knows you don’t have any”

“Ok, ok I get it, I understand why you acted like that now”

Mydei merely hummed, it seemed that was enough for Phainon to understand why he acted as such.

“I need her to turn me back, that’s why I’m looking for her” Mydei said as he put the plates back in the area to let them dry. There was no other way, unless he could find that dammed man who did this to him from the start.

It would be like therapy to deal with him.

“Oh, that make sense. If anybody could do that, I guess it would be her, but…”

Hesitation, what was Phainon thinking about now?

“What? Spit it out Deliverer, I can’t read minds”

Phainon seemed shy, he looked at the ground as he talked “It’s just- Do you really want to go back? The tail and ears look so good on you…you really look cute with them on-”

What.

What.

Mydei could feel the heat rise on face, what does he mean cute? He’s a grown 24-year-old Kremnoan warrior for Nikador’s sake-

“What?” It’s all Mydei managed to say before Phainon awkwardly continued flinging his arms all around as he tried to formulate his words.

Phainon was as red and Mydei, maybe even more so “I mean you always look cute! I mean you look cuter with the fluffy ears and the tail, and I love when I touch them and one of them twitches and then your tail is very smooth and long and you kinda purr when I touch it-“

Phainon continued to babble on and on without stopping, he was clearly not thinking as he spoke, he wasn’t even looking at Mydei anymore.

Mydei just sat there dumbfounded as he heard Phainon calling him cute and adorable ? As well as facts about his ears and tail he hadn’t even realized he had-

And he wasn’t purring before, there’s no way-

“-and I just thought that- I mean I really liked them and-“ Phainon finally looked at Mydei who was absolutely bewildered at the whole revelation, still trying to figure out what possessed Phainon to say all those things.

“-And I think we should find Cipher as you said actually! Yeah! Let’s do just that” he said, awkwardly as he walked out of the room.

Mydei sighed, as much as everything that Phainon said mortified him in some ways, it was clear that Phainon loved him and every aspect of him, new or not.

Mydei let out a sigh as he went after his boyfriend.

Now outside, it was time to face the world once more.

To mend the misunderstandings that were caused and revert back to his usual appearance.

Seriously why didn’t it fade completely?! Cipher was really just messing with him at this point.

Walking down the city  he received a lot of looks, Mydei didn’t bother to conceal his new appearance it would only be a hassle to do so.

His tail was too huge to hide it with anything that looked remotely good, and he never liked to wear any type of headwear so wearing anything new would only make him look suspicious and out of place.

He ended up making some minor modification to his outfit (Sorry Aglaea) to let the tail go out smoothly and not let it be cramped under his robes, it was so long and thick that it almost touched the ground to Mydei’s constant annoyance.

As for the people’s opinion he could hear the mumbling of the citizens around them, loud and clear “The prince is back?!”

“Titans what happened to him?”

“Are those, chimera ears and tail?”

“Does anybody know what’s going on?”

He quite literally kept walking forward without paying too much attention to what was being said, Phainon on the other hand seemed a little bit…embarrassed? Whatever for Mydei did not know.

They finally reached Kephale’s plaza where Castorice, Tribbie, Trianne and Trinnon were waiting for them.

“De!!” It’s all he heard before he saw two tiny bubbly redheads running at him.

Both Tribbie and Trianne were already next to him in an instant, with Trinnon following slowly behind the other two.

Mydei crouched to be at their level and gave them both a big hug, the two sisters hugged him as tight as they could with their small size, not daring to let him go.

He saw Trinnon hesitating, unsure of whether to join now that the embrace had already initiated.

Mydei opened one of his arms to make space for the other. Trinnon wavered for a second before joining her two sisters.

“De! We missed you so much!” Trianne said crying, her face was buried in his clothes.

“Where were you all this time De? We were so worried!” Tribbie said, in a sorrowful tone. Mydei hated that he had caused them all so much grief.

He tried his best to console them despite him being rather awkward about it.

Mydei sighed “Well…” He had to end the hug to show them properly, it was very hard to do but he managed to break it after giving each of them a gentle pat in their heads.

“…This happened” He merely turned around and let them see his tail, letting them come to their own conclusion.

He heard Castorice gasping, she had been talking to Phainon this whole time since she was trying to give them space with their reunion “Lord Mydei are those…and you also have ears- what happened?”

“De got a new tail!! That’s so cool” Said Trianne with a runny nose now going back to her cheerful self. She was trying to lift his rail from the ground with her tiny hands, as she inspected it, cute.

He turned back again to face his friends, slowly so Trianne wasn’t startled and could continue to play with his tail “First, I would like to apologize, I did not mean to cause you all so much anguish” He hated that he involved everyone into his own mess, even if he wasn’t directly at fault he couldn’t help but feel guilty, it was a situation that got out of hand rather quickly “To explain, I was…turned into a Chimera by the power of Zagreus. I was render useless as I saw every one of you trying to look for me just to come out empty handed, I’m sorry for the trouble I caused”

He had never felt so useless in his life that for sure, now looking at the surprised faces of his friends, he felt that pang of guilt resurfaces once more.

“Aww De! You don’t need to apologize for that! It was a though situation and you did your best to beat it, I’m sure of that! And Ciffy came to the rescue at the end, right? So, it all ended well! ” Tribbie tried to reassure him, both Trinnon and Trianne were enthusiastically nodding their heads as to vouch for Tribbie’s words.

“You don’t have to worry anymore Lord Mydei, it was a situation where you couldn’t do much about it. We are just happy that it all went well and that you are here with us once again” Castorice smiled as she also tried to cheer him up, maybe he was thinking too much about it…Still, he will cook all the Heirs the most delicious food as compensation to have to put up with all the mess.

He still thinks he could’ve done better “Thank you all for your reassurances. But I did try to do something about it, multiple times in fact- If only someone would’ve noticed all the signs…” He tried to stir the conversation away from the gloomy vibe he himself had created, it was no use linger on it now that everyone said it was fine.

As for Phainon, he hopes he takes on the bait.

He was not disappointed, his now boyfriend looked at him with widen eyes and a finger pointing at himself “Huh? Is that supposed to be me?”

“Ha, who else would it be if not you? You ban me form using scripts to write down my pleas and couldn’t even realize who I was even after looking at the very same eyes you claim to love” Mydei said as he crossed his arms, both Trianne and Trinnon had started to play around his tail now that Mydei was busy with Phainon.

Castorice merely stood at distance politely looking at them, she already knew what was going to transpire next.

“You- How am I even supposed to know people could turn into Chimeras! It’s just ridiculous! And you leaving the scrolls all over the floor almost killed me! I landed over my wound, and it still hurts!”

Mydei huffed, he could already call out his bullshit from a mile away “Well, if that’s the case maybe you should’ve tried harder, didn’t you claim we were soulmates earlier? Sound like something you should’ve figure out” Mydei said with a grin, he could hear Castorice gasp as she covered her mouth.

Everyone who was around the plaza started to look their way now as well, which so much commotion they were making.

“Also, stop exaggerating Deliverer, I tended to you wound today and It was perfectly fine, you even told me you barely felt it was there”

He could see how Phainon’s face grew redder by the minute, be out of anger or shame Mydei didn’t really know.

Then Phainon started making that adorable face he always made when he was mad yet still managed to look like a puppy, completely non-threatening.

That however didn’t last long, for that cute scowl turned into a bright smirk that Mydei knew it could only spell trouble “Well, I think that fate brought us together once again. This just proves that we cannot part, not even when one of us gets turn into a Chimera”  Phainon said confidently, too smug about it “And I believe if things had actually played differently and I was the one affected- I would’ve done so much better than you, in fact, I would have everyone aware of the situation in an instant”

Mydei’s eye twitched a bit as he frowned. Does this man even understand what he had to go through? How awful it was to communicate with people? “Don’t make me laugh Deliverer. You wouldn’t even survive a day as a Chimera”

“Haha, you are right, I probably would’ve turned back into a human before a day even passed”

“You-“ Mydei took a step forward, Tribbie moved behind him joining her two sisters that stopped playing around and were now looking at what was transpiring.

Phainon took a step forward as well “What is it Mydei? Chimera got your tongue?”

Another step by Mydei got him closer to Phainon, Castorice was right in the middle moving her head slightly when each of them spoke, carefully looking with one hand on her mouth.  “As if. You should know better Deliverer, speaking ok things you know nothing about”

Another step from Phainon “Well, I do have some experience dealing with you I bet I’d do a better job at being a Chimera than you”

Mydei did a final step, now they were more than face to face, they crossed the line of what it would be considered a fair distance between friends.

But they weren’t only friends anymore.

Mydei squinted his eyes “I would like to see you try”

“Then It’s a bet Mydeimos” Phainon whispered in his ear with such tone that almost gave him goosebumps.

Then Phainon kissed him.

In front of so many people, including their friends.

But Mydei didn’t care about that.

He cared about the man in front of him, who could so easily irritate him and so easily make it disappear a second later.

Mydei felt himself relaxed under Phainon’s hold, but as soon as the moment came it was gone.

Then once again Phainon whispered in his ear “Whoever reaches the Market’s rooftop first wins” Then he bolted out of the scene.

Mydei was left behind, absolutely flabbergasted. What was wrong with this man.

“Sorry, I have to teach him a lesson” Mydei apologized to his friends, who were as stunned as he was by the sudden display.

“O-oh!” That’s all Castorice managed to say before Mydei started running, he did hear her say something like “Good luck Lord Mydei” as well as two of the triplets giggling.

Phainon had the advantage due to his trick, he most likely was around at the entrance of the Market by now.

Mydei ran as fast as he could trying to catch up to his boyfriend, making sure not to trip on the stairs on his way up.

He expected to see Phainon already on the Market by the time he was at the end of the corridor, however, he was proven wrong once he saw him standing right by the entrance in front of no other than Krateros.

Oh dear.

“What got you in such a hurry boy?” Krateros said with arms crossed as he looked down at Phainon who looked like he wanted to be anywhere but here right now.

“Oh, well, I was just-“

“Competing with me” Mydei finished the sentence as he barged in between the two of them.

“You-“ Krateros said, eyes widening only for surprised to be replaced by anger, “Just where have you been? You can’t just disappear and expect nothing to happen. Your people are waiting for you, and you treat this…like…a game?” Krateros said, confused as he took a better look at Mydei, no doubt wondering why the hell the Crown Prince of Castrum Kremnos was rocking a pair of fluffy ears and a scaly tail.

“…What in the world are you wearing?” Krateros asked completely done with him as if Mydei was using these by choice.

He took a peek at his boyfriend who seemed like he was trying his best not to laugh right now.

“I’m not exactly wearing them…”

Mydei pulled his right ear up, showing Krateros that they were in fact part of his actual body and not a prop on his head.

Krateros was rightfully too stunned to speak, as he blinked a few times trying to process the information “Does this have to do with your disappearance?”

“Yes. It’s…complicated” a beat of silence  “I’m sorry I left, but it was out of my control” he added.

For a second, he thought his teacher would ask more questions, and that he would have to explain that he was a Chimera for a few days, but thankfully he didn’t.

Krateros just stayed silent for a minute trying to assess the situation “I want to talk with you in private later after you…fix yourself”

“Very well Teacher” Mydeimos said as Krateros left, no doubt to tell every Kremnoan in Okhema that he was back.

Phainon hummed “He doesn’t show it, but he seemed relieved that you are back”

Mydei had noticed as well, as much Krateros obsession with Mydei inheriting what was rightfully his, he also deeply cared for him “Indeed”

“I also thought that you might tell him, since he was here already” Phainon said as he put his head on Mydei’s shoulder.

?

What was Phainon talking about “Tell him what?”

“You know, about you and me…”

Ah.

That.

“I’d rather not do so right now. He would just stir the conversation back to the matter of the crown. I’m aware he doesn’t care who I marry as long as I inherit the throne” They had this conversation before, a few times, Mydei got tired of hearing it by now he’d rather avoid hearing it again if he can.

“M-marriage?” Phainon asked as he got off of Mydei’s shoulder, now looking directly at Mydei, he was breathless, and his eyes kept blinking.

“? What of it?” Why was Phainon so nervous all of a sudden?

“Y-you are already thinking about marrying me. I- we been together for a day????”

?

“Phainon, we are equals”  Does he really have to explain this?

“I mean yeah you had said so already I just don’t know how it ties into this?”

Mydei sighed, he guesses Phainon is not from Castrum Kremnos, and he still has much to learn about his people.

“It is quite common for equals who start a relationship to marry each other. It’s only natural that I’m thinking about our marriage already” Mydei said nonchalantly.

Phainon however seemed like he was choking on air.

“…Does the idea of marrying me displease you?...” Mydei said a little heartbroken. Maybe Phainon was more casual about his relationships, but Mydei was already thinking where their wedding would take place, the month, the invites, the officiator…

“What?!” Phainon almost shouted, pulling Mydei out of his trance “Mydei I swear to all the Titans when I tell you I would marry you in this life as many times as possible-” Suddenly Phainon got both of their hands clasped together “Forget that, I would marry you in every single one of my lives”

Mydei’s heart did a flutter, this was the man he fell in love with, he felt his eyes mellow as he saw his lover in front of him.

“I love you” Mydei said as he leaned close to kiss Phainon once more, who gladly reprecipitated the act.

For a moment the world didn’t exist, it was just Phainon and Mydei…

“Hahaha! Two Chrysos Heirs marring each other? Haven’t seen that happen in ages!”

Phainon, Mydei and an annoying lion bitch.

Mydei did everything into his power to not pow the statue into a million pieces, that is he didn’t not try at all and Phainon had to stop him instead.

Now that everything had quietened down a little bit and the first quint of the Parting Hour was in place, it was time to visit Aglaea, by now she was probably done with her duties.

They both entered the Hero’s Bath once again, the action by now was rudimentary and fully engraved into their beings.

Once again, they found themselves standing before their leader, someone that Mydei ended up respecting a lot through this journey together.

“You two are back” She greeted them as always, almost as if they just returned from a mission together.

Phainon greeted her fist, then Mydei “Hello Aglaea. I know you are already aware of my…situation” It was only natural; she must’ve heard so much already, and she could clearly see the aftereffects of course “I would like to apologize for what happened”

Aglaea didn’t react much as always “There’s no need, it was out of your control. Now you are looking for Cifera am I correct?”

It seemed like she also didn’t wish to linger too much on the topic of what happened, and she was completely right and to the point, he was indeed looking for Cipher. “Precisely so”

Aglaea merely hummed “Well you are in luck. That little kitty is still around Okhema, I can pinpoint a few locations for you to look at” How did she managed to know how to find Cipher was still a mystery to Mydei, but he appreciated the help immensely.

“That would be nice”

After struggling looking in a few locations they finally managed to fish out Cipher who in the end she was just hanging out at the rooftops in the Market area.

Mydei was holding her by the back of her clothes as if she was a kitten being grabbed by her mother “Speak, now”

“W-what do you want me to say?!” She said panicking as she flown her arms into the air.

“Mydei wants you to bring him back to normal” Phainon said, wording his exact demand.

“And tell me who did this to me” Mydei added.

“…and tell him who did this to him” Phainon repeated. 

“F-fine! Just put me down already, yes?” Cipher pleaded “Not until, you fix me”

Cipher rolled her eyes, both Phainon and Mydei were attentively looking at her so she couldn’t escape.

“Oh please, can’t you see you are already back to normal?”

“What?” Mydei said as he tried to grab his tail with his unused hand but ended up grabbing nothing.

Phainon looked at him surprised as he looked at top of his head, given his reaction it was safe to assume that the ears also disappeared as well.

…is just Mydei’s idea or was Phainon disappointed right now?

“How did you do that?” Mydei asked, rather confused, Cipher didn’t even lift a finger this time.

“Would you put me down already? Then I’ll tell you” Mydei rolled his eyes as he put Cipher back on the ground, making sure she would not escape easily if she decided t to dip.

“I just…undid the trick that was placed on you! No need to touch anything or do a chanting, is that easy, really” she said as she closed her eyes and smiled smugly, Mydei wasn’t quite buying it.

“How does that even work” Mydei asked trying to figure out exactly how things happened “What, with the power of trickery of course! If tell you, it wouldn’t be a trick anymore would it”

“Fine, keep your secrets. Tell me about the man who did this to me then” At that Cipher seemed to be sweating a little bit.

“What man?” She said rather awkwardly.

“Follower of Zagreus with long brown hair, green eyes” Mydei recalled “He was wearing a blue and white chiton when I last saw him”

Cipher instantly seemed to recognize him “Oh yeah that guy, that man- he was run by a Dromas the other day actually”

What.

“Oh yes, tragic I know” Cipher pretended to be sad, fake sobbing “Anyways that’s all I have for today, I already fix you and I have to go, bye”

In an instant she got her coin flipped and left, Mydei was left blinking on the spot.

…

He doesn’t buy it; he’ll have to have another chat with Cipher some other day.

Mydei looked at Phainon to tell him to just go back home and he looked as if he was mourning.

“…what happened now?” He asked, almost scared to do so.

“Your ears...I couldn’t give them one final touch”

Mydei just deadpan stared at him for a second before heading to the stairs.

“W-wait don’t leave me behind!”

Curtain Fall Hour had already started a while ago, after their dinner the two of them went back to Phainon’s house and decided to spend the night together.

They were both cuddling in bed and Mydei was almost falling asleep as Phainon carefully played with his hair, looking for something that wasn’t there anymore

His sleepiness went away once Phainon asked him something he wasn’t expecting. “…Mydei let’s have a Chimera”

“What?”  He turned around to look at Phainon who was looking at him with pleading eyes, almost begging.

What the hell has gotten into him?

“I lived with you as a Chimera for like four days Mydei- I just cannot believe that Meowdei is gone- I’m going through Meowdei withdrawal, I need him  back”

What.

What does that even mean.

“You want me to go back to being a Chimera?...I just got back, we even declared our feeling to each other, and you want me to-“

“No!” Phainon said, almost shouting, only to put his hand on his mouth surprised over his own volume.

“It’s just, I don’t know- I just got so used to it…you were so cute, and it helped me a lot to have you around” Why did he sound like a kicked puppy…His lover sure knew how to sound pathetic and compelling at the same time.

Mydei rolled his eyes “…We could go to the Garden of Life tomorrow and look for some of them I guess”

Phainon brightened up, if he had a tail, it would surely be waging side to side. Mydei is sure if there was another life, Phainon would’ve been a dog.

“Yes Mydei! I love you” Then Phainon kiss him, it was quick but warm, Mydei make sure to savor the short moment.

So many things happened because of that mess, and while he loathed the experience, he certainly wasn’t about to argue about the results.

He now had the love of his life by his side, something he wanted to protect more than anything.

In time, the two of them fell asleep in each other’s warm embrace with the promise to find someone special the very next day.
